(1) Seal Ring Material Operating Temperature

In HG/T 2579—2008 (General Liquid Hydraulic System O-ring Rubber Seal Ring Material), the working temperature range is divided into 40~100℃, 25~125℃ for O-ring rubber seal ring materials. In HG/T 2021—2014 (High Temperature Oil O-ring Rubber Seal Ring), the seal ring material types are divided into I, II, III and IV classes. Class I uses fluorine rubber NBR as a substitute, suitable for oil-based hydraulic fluid with a working temperature range of approximately 25~125℃, short-term up to 150℃; Class II is high-pressure sealing rubber FKM, suitable for synthetic oil with a working temperature range of approximately 20~200℃, short-term up to 250℃; Class III uses ACM and nitrile rubber rubber FKM substitutes, suitable for stone oil-based hydraulic fluid with a working temperature range of approximately 20~150℃, short-term up to 175℃; Class IV uses fluorine rubber HNBR as a substitute, suitable for stone oil-based hydraulic fluid with a working temperature range of approximately 25~150℃, short-term up to 160℃.

In HG/T 2810—2008 (Rubber Sealing Material for Hydraulic Fluid Sealing), the seal ring material is divided into A and B classes. Class A is fluorine rubber material with a working temperature range of 30~100℃; Class B is chlorine-containing rubber material with a working temperature range of 40~80℃.
(2) Seal Ring Maximum Working Temperature

According to JB/T 10205—2010 (Hydraulic Cylinder), the temperature test conditions are: under specified pressure, the sealed liquid temperature is 90℃ of the working fluid. The entire process must be carried out for 1h, and the combination of the user and the design should be determined by the maximum temperature capability requirements. Under normal circumstances, the liquid pressure working temperature should be in the 20~50℃ range. The working fluid temperature should be in the 20~80℃ range. In GB/T 7935—2005 (Hydraulic Fluid Test Method), it is specified that the test oil temperature should be 50℃±1℃. Class B is ±2.0℃, Class C is ±4.0℃. In GB/T 15622—2005 (Hydraulic Fluid Test Method), it is specified that except for special specifications, the test temperature should be 50℃±2℃, and the test should be carried out at 50℃±4℃.

In GB/T 3452.1—2005 (Hydraulic Fluid Gas Use O-ring Rubber Seal Ring Part 1 Dimension Series Public Announcement), the working temperature is specified. In JB/T 7757.2—2006 (Machine Seal O-ring Rubber Seal Ring), the working temperature range for O-ring rubber is specified as 30~100℃; rubber seal ring working temperature range is 20~200℃.

In JB/T 10706—2007 (Machine Seal Rubber Seal Ring O-ring), the working temperature range is specified as 60~200℃ (rubber seal ring with FEP as 20~180℃, rubber seal ring with PFA as 60~180℃, rubber seal ring with PFA covering as 60~200℃).

In GB/T 15242.1—2017 (Hydraulic Cylinder Active Seal Ring Dimension Series Part 1: Rod Seal Ring Dimension Series and Public Announcement), the working temperature is specified. In GB/T 15242.2—2017 (Hydraulic Cylinder Active Seal Ring Dimension Series Part 2: Piston Seal Ring Dimension Series and Public Announcement), the working temperature range is specified as 30~100℃ (sealed).
Single-acting rod seals (U-cup), -60~1200°C (fluorine rubber seals for high temperature materials), -60~150°C (polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) seals).

(3) Seal Ring Maximum Working Pressure

According to GB/T 10205—2010 (Hydraulic fluid), the test liquid is divided into two categories based on the composition of the test liquid (using test liquid at engineering rated pressure), and the test pressure is 1.5 times the rated pressure of the liquid, with a test duration of 2 minutes. The test pressure is 10s, and there should be no external leakage and component damage phenomena.
In GB/T 3452.1—2005 (Hydraulic fluid O-ring rubber seals - Part 1: Dimension series and tolerances), the maximum working pressure is specified.
In GB/T 15242.1—1994 (Hydraulic rod seals for rod seals - Dimension series and tolerances) (superseded), the maximum working pressure is specified as 40MPa.

In GB/T 10708.1—2000 (Composite dynamic rubber seals - Part 1: Single-direction rubber seals), the maximum working pressure for Y-shaped seals is specified as 25MPa, and for V-shaped combined seals as 50MPa and for V-shaped combined seals as 100MPa.

GB/T 10708.2—2000 (Composite dynamic rubber seals - Part 2: Bidirectional rubber seals) specifies the maximum working pressure for bidirectional seals as 70MPa, and the maximum working pressure for U-shaped seals as 35MPa.

GB/T 36520.1—2018 (Cryogenic seals - Part 1: Active seals for reciprocating motion) specifies the maximum working pressure for U-shaped seals as 35MPa (medium is liquid nitrogen), and the application scope is engineering seals; T-shaped combined seals, straight groove combined seals, and the maximum working pressure is 90MPa (medium is liquid nitrogen).

GB/T 36520.2—2018 (Cryogenic seals - Part 2: Stationary seals for reciprocating motion) specifies the maximum working pressure for U-shaped seals as 35MPa (medium is liquid nitrogen), and the application scope is engineering seals; single-cavity seals for high-pressure seals as 35MPa (medium is liquid nitrogen), and the application scope is engineering seals; single-cavity seals for high-pressure seals as 60MPa (medium is liquid nitrogen), and the application scope is combined type seals.
In JB/ZQ 4264—2006 (Piston Y-shaped seals) and JB/ZQ 4265—2006 (Rod Y-shaped seals), the maximum working pressure is specified as 31.5MPa.
In JB/T 982—1977 (Group seals), the maximum working pressure is specified as 40MPa.

In MT/T 985—2006 (Coal-use hydraulic and pneumatic seals technical conditions), the maximum working pressure for bidirectional seals is specified as 60MPa, and the maximum working pressure for single-direction seals is 40MPa.
(4) Corrosion Resistance and High-Pressure Seals

The selection of seal materials, structural forms, and use conditions should be based on the maximum working temperature being 90°C and the maximum working pressure being 31.5MPa for static seals (O-shaped), and for dynamic seals (piston), etc., set to be high-temperature and high-pressure seals. The seal ring isolation, high-pressure seal performance prediction ratio is difficult, mainly due to the incompatibility between seal materials and structural forms, and the use of working conditions and related factors. If the seal ring isolation and high-pressure seal performance prediction is not properly set, it will be difficult to determine whether a hydraulic seal design meets the actual working conditions (actual seal performance test).

sections.text: 2.10.7 Several Specific Issues in the Design of Hydraulic Cylinder Seal Systems
1. Groove Spacing Problem

Determine (seal) groove spacing minimum distance is the most important issue in hydraulic cylinder seal system design. Combined with the groove spacing problem, the following should be noted: Under the premise of ensuring seal performance, the hydraulic cylinder seal system design should achieve the optimal design goal. The hydraulic cylinder seal system design should not only consider the arrangement of seal components (configuration), but also consider the seal groove spacing to ensure that only the seal (seal) groove is maintained, the shape is stable, and the seal system's sealing performance is maintained.

The groove side surface of the seal component should generally be as edge, edge distance, and rigidity. The groove side surface may produce warping, and even cause the seal to be damaged, leading to seal loss.

In the hydraulic cylinder active rod piston seal system design, for the two-way seal piston rod seal system's sealing groove spacing (including anti-dust ring) seal groove spacing, if only from a certain distance, rigidity direction considerations, generally should not be less than 1.5 times the maximum depth of the groove. In the hydraulic cylinder active rod piston seal system design, due to the two-way pressure action, if the seal component groove spacing is too small from a strength, rigidity direction considerations, should be at least 1.5 times the maximum depth of the groove.
Support ring and its seal groove spacing generally should be 1.5-2 times. Special cases below should perform necessary strength verification.

(1) Support Ring Radial Problem

Generally speaking, the following principle should be used: good support ring thickness is better, but due to structural, safety, cost and other series of problems, it is impossible to achieve all the requirements for support rings (directional rings) from the polar diameter selection. According to GB/T 15242-2017 standard for liquid pressure seals and support rings, the dimensional range of support rings is provided. However, in practice, the actual size of the product may not meet the specified dimensional range, which increases the consistency between the product and the two non-conforming situations. Therefore, in Tables 2-151 to 154 (see reference document [102]), the dimensional range of support rings is provided for designers to refer to when designing liquid pressure seal systems.

(2) Support Ring Layout Issues

The liquid pressure seal system design should emphasize the overall observation of each seal component installation position, uniform distribution, and overall configuration. Since it is a passive seal system with active seal rings, it cannot simply rely on the direction and support of the seal ring itself, but should consider the liquid pressure as a whole system (design).
When designing liquid pressure seals under high pressure conditions, the support ring layout should follow the general principle:

304.page_header: Chapter 2 Design of Hydraulic Cylinders and Their Components

items: The piston seal system or piston rod seal system itself should have the largest guidance and support.
The piston or piston rod must have the largest guidance and support.
The sealing materials should preferably go through filtration (anti-fouling) so that their function is used for other seals.
The buffer seal section should preferably also have a support ring.
Other seal components are the best for support, including the dust seal ring and other seal components.

sections.text: When the support ring and connecting channel materials are selected, material hardness should be as low as possible to meet the seal quality characteristics, and should be placed in the front.
3. Setting Up Leakage Channel Issues
As shown in Figure 2-79, if possible, it is best to open a leakage channel in front of the dust seal.

sections.text: This is because: 1) Single-lip rubber dust seal rings only have dust-proof function, but do not have auxiliary seal function. 2) Even using double-lip rubber dust seal rings, achieving "zero" leakage is also very difficult. 3) Even under certain specific conditions where the external leakage of the hydraulic cylinder is "zero," once the working conditions change (such as oil temperature rising), external leakage may still occur, and the only question is how much the leakage amount is.

For this reason, as long as there is a dust-proof seal ring in front of the "leakage oil," through leakage passage introduction or open-type discharge or other open methods, the seal will always maintain "zero" pressure on the outside, and the seal performance can be maintained for a long time, the piston rod external leakage process under reduced conditions becomes as small or achieves "zero."
If the dust seal ring in front of the leakage is blocked, the commonly used method is to use a double-lip nitrile rubber seal ring.

What needs to be explained here is: (1) In GB/T 32217-2016 test display schematic diagram, the "leakage measurement port" is set to measure the position of its hydraulic cylinder leakage passage, and it should have reference and specified values. The specified "leakage collection area" (for piston rod with diameter d ≥ 36mm, length of 20mm ± 5mm) is also very important. (2) Currently, many products have the leakage channel set at the second seal ring of the piston rod seal system, and this approach is incorrect.
4. Selection of Single and Double Dust Seal Ring Issues
The dust seal ring is an important component of the piston rod seal system, and it should be given due attention.

In GB/T 10708.3-2000 (reciprocating motion rubber seal ring structural dimensions series, Part 3: rubber dust seal ring), three basic forms of dust seals are specified. Among these, one type is a double-lip dust seal ring.

In the piston rod seal system, when you want to achieve "zero" piston rod leakage, it is not whether a single-lip or double-lip is used that matters, but rather whether a single-lip dust seal ring is sufficient as long as one leakage collection is done.
In coaxial seal systems with piston rod dust-proof seals, regardless of whether the coaxial sealing components have a "rod return" function, double-lip dust seals are used.
For stepped-form sealing components (stepped-form sealing and dust-proof combined), in the piston rod seal system, generally single-lip dust seals are used.

Single-lip dust rings and double-lip dust rings have been collectively called single-use dust rings. Dust rings in the cylinder travel during the process (referred to as the rod section) can also have the function of removing surface dirt and pollutants, such as mud, dust, and moisture (water); and another function of the double-use ring is to remove (exclude) all remaining oil film of the seal component between the seal surfaces, this is a double-use dust seal component. But regardless of whether single-use or double-use, as per GB/T 10708.3-2000, if pressure applied is at the pressure value, it may still be possible to leak.

Dust-proof seals — even without applied pressure or rated constant pressure conditions, mainly are non-pressure seals, that is to say there are mainly non-pressure dust seals, because they do not have oil-sealing function.

Commonly used lip-type rubber dust rings and polyurethane rubber dust rings need to be replaced regularly. Floating or submerged ring-type dust ring materials may also be made of glass fiber reinforced nylon or similar materials. Regarding abrasion requirements, they are not strictly required, reducing the wear rate and extending service life, especially for piston rod seal reciprocating motion, when the dust seal ring wears during the stroke.

In GB/T 24946-2010, the load efficiency ratio is specified. In GB/T 13342-2007, JB/T 10205-2010 and DB44/T 1169.1-2013, the load efficiency ratio of the hydraulic cylinder is specified. In GB/T 24946–2010, the durability index is specified. In the use period specified in the standard, the service life is not less than the repeated operation cycle specified. In JB/T 10205–2010 and DB44/T 1169.1–2013, the durability index standards are relatively consistent. Other JB/T 10205–2010 and DB44/T 1169.1–2013 standards specify durability index standards that are relatively consistent, but the test method is different from the durability requirement, which is "liquid pressure cylinder oil film leakage shall not exceed the specified value of 2 times". In GB/T 13342–2007, the "external leakage" comparison in the cylinder piston rod durability test is combined with the principle that it is impossible to completely eliminate piston rod oil film leakage. Therefore, in JB/T 10205–2010 and DB44/T 1169.1–2013, the specified "external leakage shall not exceed 2 times the specified value, and there is no difference in the shape of the cylinder". The piston rod oil film leakage is specified. In GB/T 24946–2010 and DB44/T 1169.1–2013, the durability requirement is specified as the basic requirement. According to the digital cylinder, the service life is not less than 1.5 times the rated pressure (保压 5min), and all components should not have leakage or deformation, welding seams should not have leakage and service pressure cylinder oil film leakage.

In JB/T 10205–2010, the pressure test is specified. The test liquid pressure is applied separately at different working positions. The pressure is applied at 1.5 times the rated pressure. The test type ensures pressure for 2min, and the test pressure is maintained for 10s. There should be no external leakage and component deformation. sections.text: 2.11 Design of Hydraulic Cylinder Piston Rod Hydrostatic Support Structure
1. General

The working principle of the piston rod hydrostatic support structure (hydraulic hydrostatic sliding bearing guiding the piston rod) is that the support force on the piston rod is mainly generated by external pressurized oil, rather than generated by the relative motion between the piston rod and its hydrostatic support sleeve (i.e., hydrodynamic effect).

The hydraulic hydrostatic bearing shaft in the sliding bearing guides the piston rod to reciprocate while bearing the loads acting on the piston rod. The piston rod hydrostatic support structure discussed in this manual includes the hydrostatic sliding bearing guiding the piston rod and its sliding contact components.

Generally, the design of piston rod hydrostatic support structures should follow these principles: under the maximum load that may be encountered, the minimum oil film thickness should at least maintain lubricating oil film thickness of 50%~60%.

In design, the eccentricity ratio (where the load eccentricity is the relative eccentricity ratio e = e/C₀) is limited to e = 0~0.5 in the range; the flow rate designed for the medium should be the set flow rate. This is because the hydrostatic support's ability to compensate for special eccentricity is at its strongest. It is also necessary to consider the hydrostatic support structure's load-bearing capacity, and there must be sufficient consideration for the forces acting in the oil cavity due to oil and the load acting on the oil cavity surface due to tightening, as well as the situation of reduced rigidity. It is especially important to note that one type of phenomenon is the eccentricity of the piston rod bending deflection leading to an offset from the center, and in the case of the piston rod hydrostatic support sleeve edge contact friction type hydrostatic support structure.

The design and calculation of the piston rod hydrostatic support structure is established on the basis of static (including front and boundary condition requirements). Whether enough determination of its operating parameters and operating conditions, geometry and shape, oil supply capacity, eccentricity ratio, load-bearing capacity, oil temperature and other functional relationships, as well as oil supply pressure, flow rate, friction power, temperature rise and other parameters, often needs to be verified by actual machines.
2. Structural Types

In common piston rod hydrostatic support bearing designs, the hydrostatic support sleeve has oil grooves between them, with 4 oil cavities or more (even number of cavities). The oil cavity depth is the groove depth (diameter direction C₀) 10 times or more, and the length-to-diameter ratio B/D is 0.3~1. This is the most commonly used structural type for this application.

This type, with and without oil return grooves, has a similar structure; under the same return oil pressure conditions, the type without oil return grooves requires a larger oil supply flow rate. The hydrostatic support sleeve is connected to the cylinder head by means of possible connections. As follows:
Using medium-type press-fit assembly, take necessary measures to prevent extreme working conditions from causing connection failure (loosening) or even total failure.
3. Basic Parameters

The basic parameters of piston rod hydrostatic support structure include: hydrostatic support sleeve inner diameter D₁, outer diameter D₀, width B, number of oil cavities Z, axial oil seal strip width b₁, circumferential oil seal strip width b₂, oil return groove width, oil cavity depth, oil return groove depth (equivalent to the bearing return pressure), and throttle type (such as small orifice throttle type, capillary tube type, internal feedback type, etc.). Hydrostatic support sleeve (i.e., bearing sleeve) material: cast alloy conforms to the requirements of GB/T 18324-2001; cast copper alloy conforms to JB/T 7921-1995 requirements; forged copper alloy conforms to JB/T 7922-1995 requirements.

Force transducers can receive and output multiple input conversions into their constituent ratio output (usually called electrical parameters) devices, as defined in GB/T 33010–2016 for transducer technical requirements.

The pressure transducer's pressure range, its bearing's transducer performance indicators should comply with the pressure range's technical requirements. 1) GB/T 7665–2005 (Transducer Application Language) and various standard specifications for pressure range and definition should be met. 2) Transducer naming and code according to GB/T 7666–2005 regulations. Force transducers are used for theoretical transmission, in hydraulic cylinders under normal heavy load (weight) transducers, while force transducers should not be used for force sensing transducers. 2.13.3  Technical Requirements for Pressure Transducers Used in Hydraulic Systems
Pressure transducers are sensors that sense pressure and convert it into usable output signals. In JB/T 6170—2006, the technical requirements for pressure transducers are specified.
Pressure transducers belong to physical quantity sensors. In hydraulic systems, pressure transducers, absolute pressure transducers, and differential pressure transducers are commonly used.
1. Basic Parameters

(1) Measurement Range
The measurement range of the transducer should comply with the product technical conditions (detailed specifications). Except for special regulations, the transducer measurement range should be selected from the following series: 1×10³, 1.6×10³, 2×10³, 2.5×10³, 3×10³, 4×10³, 5×10³, 6×10³, 8×10³.
Where n is the number of digits, n = 0, ±1, ±2, ±3···.
The unit of measurement range is Pa, kPa, MPa, GPa.

(2) Pressure Transducer Sensing Type
1) Gauge pressure transducer (pᵣ).
2) Absolute pressure transducer (pₐ).
3) Differential pressure transducer (pₐ).

(3) Measured Medium Type
Related to the type of medium in contact with the pressure transducer, such as gas, liquid, corrosive medium, non-corrosive medium, etc.

(4) Material of Measured Medium Contact Parts
List the names and grades of materials in contact with the measured medium.

(5) Installation Method
If the maximum installation angle or distance from the transducer is not specified, specific provisions should be made.

(6) Direction
The axis direction of the pressure transducer port (i.e., the direction of medium entry into the transducer) is defined as the measurement direction, and the direction perpendicular to this is defined as the Y direction.

(7) Sealing
The transducer should have no leakage at the sealing joint, and should comply with the sealing material and sealing method requirements. The transducer body should have protective requirements, and should comply with the protection level and protection grade specified in GB/T 4208.

(8) Electrical Connection Method
Provide output connector numbering, electrical connection principle diagram, and necessary instructions.

(9) Excitation
The transducer excitation should comply with the product technical conditions (detailed specifications).

(10) Working Temperature Range
The working temperature range of the transducer should comply with the product technical conditions (detailed specifications). It is recommended to select from the following five levels:
1) Commercial grade: 0~70°C.
2) Industrial grade: -25~85°C.
3) Automotive grade: -30~100°C.
4) Military grade: -55~125°C.
5) Special grade: -60~350°C.

(11) Storage Temperature Range
The storage temperature range of the transducer should not exceed the limit temperature that is 10°C lower than the lower working temperature and 15~20°C higher than the upper working temperature.
2. Technical Requirements

(1) Product Technical Conditions (detailed specifications)
Transducers must comply with the basic technical requirements and related product technical conditions (detailed specifications). When the technical requirements specified in the product technical conditions (detailed specifications) are inconsistent, the product technical conditions (detailed specifications) shall prevail.

(2) Appearance
The external appearance of the transducer should have no obvious defects, cracks, rust, and corrosion damage; the screw parts should have no burrs; the markings should be clear and complete, allowing for clear identification of the model.

sections.text: 4. LWH Series Direct-Acting Linear Position Transmitter
(1) Product Introduction

The LWH series direct-acting linear position transmitter and BTL7 series rod magnetic linear displacement transmitter are different. It is a direct-acting linear displacement transmitter. This series of transmitter is used for displacement and stroke control in measurement and control systems. The position and stroke measurement range can reach 900mm, with high resolution (0.01mm) and can provide sufficient linearity and repeatability of displacement measurement. The internal structure of the transmitter is specially treated, which can effectively reduce friction and wear during operation. The transmitter front end has a soft elastic shaft that can overcome the lateral force during operation, ensuring normal operation of the transmitter. The structural design takes into account the installation of electronic components and sealing.

The fixing of the transmitter electrical material to the fixed structure design and other processes ensure that even under harsh conditions, the sensor can still work normally. The transmitter front surface must be installed horizontally. This is because if the sensor is installed at an angle, it will cause the guide material to be installed at an angle, which will reduce the life of the sensor. This series of transmitter has the following characteristics: a) Under the condition of not applying external force, the service life reaches 10×10^6 times. b) Wire advantage, resolution up to 0.04%. c) Resolution greater than 0.01mm. d) High operating speed. e) Equipped with DIN 43650 standard plug head and plug base (pressure plug head). f) Protection level up to IP 55. In addition, the following is also stated: a) Non-ferrous material is used for the shell. b) Installation uses a pressure-type adjustment to fix the clamp. c) The pull rod is made of stainless steel (1.4305), can rotate, M6 external thread. d) The shaft uses elastic rubber shaft. e) The resistance element uses guide plastic. f) The sliding group uses bronze and self-lubricating brush. g) The electrical connector conforms to DIN 43650 standard 4 pin plug.

sections.text: 2.14 Design of Hydraulic Cylinder Exhaust Air Valve, Dust Prevention and Other Components and Devices
2.14.1 Technical Requirements for Hydraulic Cylinder Exhaust Air Devices
1. Technical Requirements for Hydraulic Cylinder Exhaust Air Devices

The exhaust air system is an important component of the hydraulic cylinder. The hydraulic system must be equipped with necessary exhaust air devices (valves) to prevent air from being trapped in the cylinder (chamber). When the requirement cannot be met, corresponding repair materials should be supplied; there should be no "air leakage" from the exhaust air valve to avoid danger. The hydraulic cylinder should use the exhaust air valve to ensure no air remains in the chamber.

According to GB/T 3766—2015, when installing hydraulic cylinders on fixed industrial machinery, liquid exhaust valves should be installed at the highest point of the cylinder. When this requirement cannot be met, corresponding repair materials should be supplied; there should be no "air leakage" from the exhaust air valve to avoid danger. The hydraulic cylinder should use the exhaust air valve to ensure no air remains in the chamber.
According to GB/T 2001 (also known as GB/T 13342—2007), the hydraulic cylinder is generally equipped with an exhaust device.
According to GB/T 24946—2010, digital cylinders should be equipped with exhaust devices.

sections.text: 2.14.3 Technical Requirements for Hydraulic Control Valves in Hydraulic Cylinder Integrated Systems

For hydraulic cylinders with hydraulic control valves, including directional control valves, pressure valves, and proportional/servo control valves, it is recommended to use integrated or modular installation methods.

The public pressure and characteristic performance indicators of hydraulic control valves (hereinafter referred to as control valves) shall not be lower than the technical requirements for the hydraulic pressure on the valve; the installation surface where the valve is mounted shall meet the relevant standards for the mounting hole spacing.

The protection level of the control valve, working pressure level, and electrical connection shall comply with relevant standards. In general, the electrical control element should be equipped with a manual override control device.
1. Technical Requirements for Hydraulic Control Valve Application
(1) Selection of Hydraulic Pressure

Select the hydraulic pressure of the valve type based on its sealing performance, durability, and corrosion resistance, as well as the impact of the machine or environmental factors. For fixed-type industrial machinery, the system should select the valve type according to the safety standards applicable to these safety-critical applications. When isolation valves are required, isolation check valves should be used.
(2) Installation of Hydraulic Pressure
When installing the control valve, consider the following aspects:

items: Independent support, no rigid connection to the pipe or manifold block.
Use vibration isolation, damping, or shock absorption.
Weight, impact, and vibration of the valve.
Use a vibration isolator, install threaded holes and electrical connection locations with sufficient space.
Avoid stress concentration at the installation location.
Prevent direct mechanical operation and installation stress.
During operation, ensure that the valve is positioned to prevent air pockets or gas accumulation.

sections.text: (3) Oil Circuit Block

items: The surface roughness and surface finish of the oil circuit block. On the oil circuit surface, the valve mounting surface and surface finish shall comply with the valve control surface finish requirements.
Deformation. Under fixed working pressure and temperature conditions, the oil circuit block shall not deform due to pressure changes.
Safety. Ensure that the oil circuit block is sealed.

Internal flow passage. The internal flow passage is located in the cross-flow area of the valve block, with the minimum cross-sectional area to minimize pressure drop. Rotation and mechanical friction on the valve block surface should be avoided. If the oil circuit block has sharp edges or burrs, they should be removed.
Identification. Oil circuit blocks shall be marked with ISO 16874 identification.

sections.text: (Complying with GB/T 36997—2018) Specification and attachment label. If the label cannot be used, other identification methods shall be provided.
(4) Solenoid Valve

items: Electrical connection. Electrical connections shall comply with GB/T 5226.1 or the standards of the manufacturer, and shall comply with the protection level design (such as GB/T 4208).
Electrical iron. Select the appropriate electrical iron (such as switching frequency, temperature range, and pressure difference) to ensure reliable operation.

Manual or lever control. When manual or lever control is required, if the solenoid valve must be operated by the control valve, the control method shall be selected according to the solenoid valve control method. When the solenoid valve control method is selected, the operation risk shall be minimized, and the solenoid valve control shall be removed from the fixed position, except for fixed positions.

sections.text: (5) Adjustment
When adjusting one or more parameters, the following shall be specified:

items: Safe adjustment method.
Locking adjustment method, such as whether the adjustment can be changed.
Prevent adjustment from exceeding the safe closure method.

sections.text: 2. Technical Requirements for Pressure Control Valves

The main function of pressure control valves is to control the pressure of the circuit. According to the standard definition of pressure control valves, pressure control valves include: pressure relief valves, pilot-operated pressure relief valves, pressure reducing valves, pilot-operated pressure reducing valves, sequence valves, single-direction sequence valves, external control pressure relief valves, solenoid valves (proportional), solenoid valves (proportional) pressure reducing valves, digital solenoid valves, hydraulic pressure force amplifiers, and others (control valves, proportional valves, pilot-operated valves, etc.).

For pressure control valves in hydraulic cylinder control systems, the control circuit pressure shall be adjusted by changing the control pressure in the control circuit, and the control circuit shall have the ability to control the pressure in the control circuit.

sections.text: 4. Directional control valve technical requirements

The main function is to control the direction of hydraulic fluid flow, connecting the blocking and opening of multiple flow passages to control the direction of the valve. Standard directional control valves include: straight-through, straight-angle, manual and hand wheel switching valves, hydraulic and electric switching valves, hydraulic electromagnetic directional valves, hydraulic electric switching directional valves, hydraulic electric magnetic directional valves, hydraulic pressure path directional valves, electrical control (proportional) three (four) way flow control valves, dual directional combined valves and ball valves, etc. The hydraulic electric switching directional valve and pilot directional valve reverse pressure loss and hydraulic single directional valve reverse opening maximum control pressure and directional control valve minimum control pressure definition is different.
(1) Technical Requirements for Hydraulic Multi-way Directional Control Valves
1) General Requirements

items: The nominal pressure of multi-way directional control valves shall comply with GB/T 2346 (Hydraulic Transmission System and Components - Nominal Pressure Series) regulations.

Screw connection oil port type and size shall comply with GB/T 2878.1 (Hydraulic Transmission Connectors - Screw Connectors and O-ring Seals for Oil Ports - Part 1: Oil Port) regulations.

2.14.4  Hydraulic Filter Technical Requirements

To maintain the required cleanliness of hydraulic oil and prevent pollution, the hydraulic system returns to the response to improve the filter. If using the main filter system (such as oil return pipe filter), does not meet the required liquid oil filter pollution or has higher filter requirements, can use bypass filter system. Filter response should be set in the pressure pipeline, return pipeline and/or suction pipeline in the circuit, to ensure the required oil cleanliness. All filters should be equipped with indicator gauges, so that the filter response is easy to operate by personnel or to protect personnel observation. When unable to meet the requirements, in the operation personnel hand should be clearly marked period before replacing the filter. Filter response should be installed easy to disassemble, and should be provided with sufficient space for convenient replacement. Do not block the suction pipeline with filters, and do not install filters as the main system. Can use suction port filter network to protect the filter.
The core pressure rating should be based on the system's maximum working pressure.
Flow through the filter without filter liquid does not produce hazard.
Do not install filters on the suction pipeline, and do not install filters on the servo valve inlet pipeline. Due to the possibility of filter blockage or servo valve loss of function, therefore in the oil pipeline near the proportional or servo valve should be installed without bypass filter.
The core pressure rating should be based on the system's maximum working pressure.
Flow through the filter without filter liquid does not produce hazard.

sections.text: 2.14.5 Hydraulic Isolation Intelligent Device Technical Requirements

In a closed hydraulic system and circuit, when the system is shut down, the hydraulic system should automatically shut off the backup device's hydraulic pressure control at the bottom isolation function. In the machine shutdown or when there is no need to maintain pressure on the hydraulic device, the pressure can be maintained without maintaining the main pressure hazard (such as equipment weight). Under the special circumstances, it is not necessary to shut off (oil or gas isolation) the backup device. In special cases, it may be necessary to protect the isolation function to prevent air side leakage. If the closed hydraulic system has elements and components that may cause danger, it should be protected. The backup device should provide instructions for air isolation devices and should not exceed the backup device's specified limit value.

sections.text: 2.15.2  Installation Methods and Connection Forms of Hydraulic Cylinders

Hydraulic cylinders with hydraulic pressure have fixed installation positions on the machine. If the hydraulic cylinder is a separate hydraulic element (component), it is a single functional unit, and serves as the hydraulic transmission system's single functional component.

The size of the hydraulic cylinder as a single functional unit is smaller than the beam's strength and rigidity, but it also has advantages: a) The hydraulic cylinder can be professionally manufactured by the main factory and can be externally supplied. b) The installation of the hydraulic cylinder on the machine structure is simplified. c) The hydraulic cylinder design, manufacturing, testing, inspection and maintenance are more convenient and flexible. d) It facilitates the standardization, serialization and modularization of hydraulic cylinders.
The hydraulic cylinder has 64 installation types specified in GB/T 9094—2006, but there are still some gaps in the hydraulic cylinder.
1. Trunnion Connection, Flange Installation Type

Hydraulic cylinders use trunnion installation before or after the trunnion, flange at the front of the cylinder, and no installation at the rear of the cylinder (i.e., on the hydraulic cylinder base). The trunnion connection is the same as the hydraulic pressure and GB/T 9094—2006 specified.

The hydraulic cylinder has trunnion connection, rear trunnion connection and front trunnion connection three installation types; the connection also has side connection, side connection and side connection and other types; the trunnion connection hole is generally smooth, using screw holes.
(1) Front End Installation Type

The front end is based on the reference point and the trunnion inner surface close fit, through the connection screw (bolt) to fix the pressure on the trunnion. During operation, due to the fixed connection surface being mutually exclusive, the trunnion must transmit force, because the trunnion (cylinder) passes through the load at the application point, which is easy to produce bending stress. In addition, the trunnion connection hole is also prone to be damaged.

It also has the front end method close to the reference surface and the trunnion inner surface close fit design. During operation, through the fixed connection surface to separate, the connection screw (bolt) receives increased load, and the friction force can be reduced, but there is no change in the trunnion (cylinder) load situation.
(2) Rear End Installation Type

The rear end method is based on the reference point and the trunnion inner surface close fit, through the connection screw (bolt) to fix the pressure on the trunnion. During operation, the pipe is usually fixed on the connection surface and the trunnion, the trunnion must transmit force, but the front end installation type is different in the direction of force, so the trunnion connection is different.
(3) Front End Flange Installation Type

The front end flange is based on the reference point and the trunnion inner surface close fit, through the pressure ring to fix the connection. The pressure ring through the screw (bolt) tightens the cylinder base with its own type, ensuring this screw connection.

This installation type is most commonly used, and in GB/T 9094—2006 it is specified for this installation type. This installation type's load situation and front end method connection are similar, but there is no trunnion connection, the load situation is generally improved, but the flange and cylinder (cylinder) through the load concentration at the application point still exists.
2. Piston Rod Sliding Block Connection Type
In GB 28241—2012 and JB/T 4174—2014, the sliding block is defined as a component that performs reciprocating motion and is installed on the main working part of the hydraulic cylinder sliding block.

In GB 2350—1980, the connection screw thread three types are specified (internal thread—one type, external thread—one type). In GB/T 9094—2006, the belt external thread active screw end, belt plate below (with internal thread) of the screw thread, belt column screw of the screw thread, belt column of the external thread of the screw thread, and belt screw thread outside the thread distance and GB 2350—1980 specified screw thread (external) thread distance is not specified.

Also for the active screw end control ball surface, through the active screw thread control ball surface, the ball surface block is in the active screw thread part to slide back, forming the active screw and sliding block ball connection.
(1) Rigid Connection
The active screw and sliding block rigid connection is the most common connection type, generally the active screw is rigidly connected with the sliding block.

Due to the active screw end type is not uniform and the end type is diverse, the hydraulic cylinder screw and sliding block connection also has diverse types, but must ensure safety, reliability, use of various forms, any connection with the hydraulic cylinder selection of elements, the sliding block has no risk of falling off during operation.
The active screw and sliding block rigid connection type is as follows:

a) Connection through threaded holes in the law.
b) Connection by bolts embedded in the pressure group.
c) Screw direct fastening connection.
d) Fixed set connection.
Refer to GB/T 9094—2006, threaded hole method is called counterbore hole method.
(2) Rotating Connection

When the shaft rotates, the shaft and the bearing seat are actively engaged with the block connection form, the active seat and the sliding block can be moved to rotate, this connection form is also the most common. However, a general hydraulic machine precision requirements are high, so the shaft diameter is large, so it is mainly used for metal-added hydraulic machine shaft, and a kind of ball screw bearing connection is often used in the hydraulic machine.
The ball screw bearing connection of the active seat end ball surface is generally the removal of material of the ball surface, a ball center hole with threaded center hole; the active seat shaft section ball and the ball surface are composed of a ball screw, this ball screw bearing connection is mainly used in the hydraulic machine work to reduce the ball pressure. The ball screw bearing connection should be periodically lubricated to prevent the ball from slipping in the work during the ball pressure change.
The hydraulic machine liquid pressure is a special structural dual screw bearing connection, its characteristic is the active seat rod bearing connection force to the block, and the use of the middle selection rod, that is, the active seat rod through a ball screw bearing connection to the middle selection rod, the middle selection rod another end ball screw bearing surface will force back to the block, because this seat rod and the block have two ball screw bearing connections, this connection form is more to eliminate the gap (friction) force application, the hydraulic machine because the use of long life is longer.

To ensure the bolt connection is reliable and to achieve the design function, the preload must be determined by the actual use conditions and the degree of tightness calculation. In safe use, the preload must reach the initial preload. Therefore, the appropriate tightening method should be selected and the tightening torque should be calibrated to control the preload to the required value.
The relationship between the preload in the elastic deformation zone and the preload is expressed by formula (2-78):
Tₜ = Tₛ + Tₑ = KFₜd  (2-78)
Tₛ = (Fₜ/2)(P/π + μₛd₂sec α')  (2-79)
Tₑ = (Fₜ/2)μₛDₛ  (2-80)
When the contact surface is circular:
Dₛ = (2/3) × (d₃⁴ - d₁⁴)/(d₃² - d₁²)  (2-81)
In the formula: Tₜ—total torque;

items: Tₛ—screw torque;
Tₑ—friction torque;
K—torque coefficient;
Fₜ—initial preload or preload;
d—screw nominal diameter;
P—pitch;
μₛ—screw friction coefficient;
d₂—screw pitch diameter;
α'—screw tooth angle;
μₛ—support surface friction coefficient;
Dₛ—support surface friction radius;
d₃—contact support surface diameter;

sections.text: 2.15.9 Servo Hydraulic Cylinder Special Gap-free Ball Screw Series

In servo hydraulic cylinder control pressure cylinder systems, hydraulic pressure and pre-tension coexist, and the two are often in relative motion. When the two are locked together, it may cause the system to produce dynamic performance differences, excessive vibration amplification, which should be avoided. The system should have sufficient 'heavy interval' dynamic stiffness.

Therefore, to reduce system dynamic stiffness variation, small gap 'heavy interval' is very necessary. As shown in Figures 2-162 and 2-163, this is a type of inclined plane position displacement sensor that controls the pressure cylinder rod end gap-free ball screw and bottom end gap-free ball screw shape diagram. Chapter 3 Manufacturing of Hydraulic Cylinders
3.1 Selection of Common Machine Tools for Hydraulic Cylinder Processing
3.1.1 Overview

This section mainly introduces metal cutting machine tools. Metal cutting machine tools can be divided into general-purpose machine tools, special machine tools, special machine tools and combined machine tools, etc. Hydraulic cylinder processing and manufacturing machine tools include lathes, boring machines, drilling machines, milling machines, grinding machines, honing machines, gear hobbing machines (spiral gear hobbing machines) and machining centers. Currently, CNC machine tools have become the mainstream for processing. CNC machine tools are selected according to the processing requirements and the sequence of the process. The control system issues digital signals to control the main motion and feed motion of the machine tool. The main factors affecting the machine tool model and the technical parameters include: machine tool precision, dimensional accuracy, surface roughness, and the selection of processing methods to determine the processing method, determine the processing accuracy of the machine tool, and whether the machine tool can achieve the required accuracy. The machine tool processing accuracy is generally not higher than the machine tool accuracy detection. It is necessary to check the causes of errors in the machine tool operation, determine the accuracy and repeatability of the machine tool, and the precision requirements of the work. The inspection method is related to the corresponding national standards. The work accuracy of the machine tool can generally not exceed the machine tool accuracy detection. This type of machine tool is a hydraulic-driven machine tool. The technical parameters in the technical specifications include requirements for the hydraulic pressure system and pressure oil, so it is possible to use this machine tool as a reference for the design of the hydraulic pressure system of the machine tool. The manual or automatic control of the hydraulic pressure drive line shaft position accuracy and the repeated positioning accuracy inspection is also used as a reference for hydraulic cylinder testing.

sections.text: 9. Minimum Fixed Unit Positioning Test
(1) Test method

First, quickly move the moving part of the machine tool along the running axis to the positive direction (or reverse direction - fixed stop position), then stop. Use this position as the reference position. Then move in the opposite direction several times to give the 1st, a total of 20 minimum fixed unit positioning commands, move the moving part to move and stop. Measure the stop position of each command. Then move to the maximum position, continue in the same direction to give out several minimum fixed unit positioning commands, so that the moving part moves and stops. From this position in the negative (or positive) direction, give out several minimum fixed unit positioning commands, so that the moving part moves and stops. Approximately return to the last measured position. In this direction, the number of minimum fixed unit positioning commands to the moving part's stop position is not less than the measurement. Then from the last measured position in the opposite direction, give out 20 minimum fixed unit positioning commands, continue in the same direction to give out several minimum fixed unit positioning commands, so that the moving part moves and stops. Approximately return to the measured position. Measure its position at each command's stop position, as shown in Figure 3-2.

3. Basic Requirements for Process Specification Design

1) Process specifications are the technical basis for guiding production operations. They should be accurate, complete, clear, and standardized.
2) On the basis of not using non-enterprise-owned production conditions, it is not allowed to use domestic or foreign advanced process technology and experience.
3) Under the premise of ensuring product quality, it is necessary to improve labor productivity and reduce consumption.
4) Process specifications must consider safety and industrial hygiene.
5) Structural characteristics and process characteristics of similar parts should be typical process specifications.
6) Each professional process specification in the design process should be coordinated and consistent, and should not be contradictory.
7) The width and format of process specifications should be in accordance with JB/T 9165-1998 (Process Specification Format and Symbol Representation Method).
8) The terminology, symbols, and abbreviations used in process specifications should comply with relevant standards.
9) The units of measurement in process specifications should comply with the prescribed units.
10) The numbering of process specifications should comply with JB/T 9166-1998 (Process Specification Numbering Method).

3.5 Hydraulic Cylinder Process Equipment Design and Use
3.5.1 Significance of Adopting Process Equipment for Cylinder Bore Machining

Professional cylinder manufacturers produce internal bore grinding, cold rolling, honing of seamless steel pipes or per JB/T 11718-2013 (Hydraulic Cylinder Barrel Technical Conditions) specified cylinders. Commonly, hydraulic cylinder manufacturers use these cylinders for hydraulic cylinder body manufacturing. For single piece and small batch hydraulic cylinder barrel manufacturing, this has the advantages of being fast, convenient, and low cost. It has been widely used in recent years.

CNC controlled lathe machine tools use combined tool holders for machining (turning and rolling) cylinders that can also be called hydraulic cylinder barrels. In cylinder manufacturing, except for the seamless steel pipe bore that has already been finished, the outer surface, both ends, and the two end face machining (generally only requiring outer surface machining) is performed. The cylinder barrel and cylinder bottom, cylinder head, and other connections (including press-fitting welding, etc.) also require machining. Therefore, at least secondary machining is required to achieve the various design requirements of hydraulic cylinder barrels, including process requirements.

The above-mentioned internal bore drilling, cold rolling (or hot rolling), seamless tube hydraulic cylinder body is a finished or semi-finished product, collectively referred to as the cylinder barrel.

In order to achieve quality assurance for each cylinder bore hole during secondary machining, the straightness, roundness, and several geometric accuracy requirements need to be guaranteed. In practice, one common method is to machine the cylinder barrel outer surface while on the lathe, and then use the outer surface to support the bore through center support and outer clamping for further machining of the cylinder barrel outer frame. This is an important process requirement for the cylinder barrel, but if the cylinder barrel is not used for machining the outer barrel, and subsequent processes are then carried out, this would have been completed. However, it is not satisfactory because the bore machining requirement is also added, and it reduces the cylinder barrel's simplicity. Therefore, many users require the cylinder barrel to have no deformation allowed for secondary machining, which actually limits the user's needs.

It is also mentioned that there can be a challenge in requiring the simultaneous determination of the alignment of both bore ends with the center of the machine tool's center line, thus making it even more difficult. There are two fitting methods, and all methods have a common characteristic where one end is a straight line connection, otherwise another end cannot achieve the alignment. The fitting/assembly must not cause bore deformation or damage. The wire connection fitting's resistance and its external force capability can be quite limited. To improve the anti-vibration capability and other capabilities, it is common practice to first add a processing front end, then use a tail frame to provide support for the cylinder barrel, and then process by removing this section of front end material. Adding a processing front end to the cylinder barrel outer wall also poses the same problem; the section of front end material should not cause the bore to deform. The connection method for this section is critical.

There is also a type of fixed-length mandrel expansion-type cylinder bore inner hole, and the issue is that after clamping, the bore at several hole locations may be damaged. The same issue requires that the mandrel must also have a certain length fixed-length mandrel, and questions arise about how to address this. The process tool provides a one-type vehicle-mounted fixed-length mandrel clamping process equipment. This equipment can utilize a card disk expansion type cylinder barrel for single end clamping. The process tool design requirement for the cylinder barrel section is not to require machining of the outer surface. That is, without using the cylinder barrel outer surface for machining processing, the outer wall equivalent sections are then machined again for further processing. Rather, the direct process tool can achieve the cylinder barrel's usage as one type (a fixed-type mandrel) and can be reused.

The process tool fixed-type mandrel approach to this type of process equipment can guarantee product quality and reliability. It can also serve as the equivalent equipment for quality assurance purposes. However, due to the need for increased production volume and expanded production scale, under the condition of not reducing product quality, such as the company's RAS system cylinder barrel process tool machine tool, the main machine does not allow all cylinder barrel inner diameter bore to be machined. The process tool base standard method makes regulations, and commonly uses the bore diameter of the inner wall for fixation or the straightness standard, which is not possible. In practice, the process tool's choosing approach for the cylinder barrel is required. After comparing the cylinder barrel inner bore with the cylinder barrel inner bore honing (or rolling) specifications, the main difference is: the cylinder barrel inner bore honing (or rolling) precision and cylinder barrel specifications are not needed (it is sufficient to only have no apparent misalignment, i.e., uniform roundness). For another cylinder barrel inner bore center position deviation, screw thread pattern, there exists a certain degree of position deviation. Using this technique, the cylinder barrel must also undergo a further precision machining step, and its cylinder barrel's specifications would also need to meet certain standards, which is not possible. Therefore, the cylinder barrel process tool (specifically the process fixtures used for this particular process equipment) is needed.

3.6.1 Quality Problems in Honing Process

The honing hole is generally the last process in the honing cylinder. However, the cylinder bore diameter after honing shows poor surface quality, which often causes quality problems in the honing hole. This is a common occurrence.

The honing hole is a hydraulic tool that uses metal abrasive material to work under pressure, causing plastic deformation of the surface layer. From the perspective of material mechanics, the honing hole is a plastic deformation process. The honing hole uses pressure to deform the surface layer, producing residual compressive stress.
The plastic deformation of the honing hole is divided into three principles: bending deformation principle, flow deformation principle, and shear deformation principle.
Note: In GB/T 4863-2008, the Chinese definition of "honing hole" is: "using pressure method to hone the hole."

3.9.5  Design Considerations for Hydraulic Cylinder Cushioning Devices

Hydraulic cylinder cushioning with cushioning devices means that when the motion body approaches the end of its stroke, it is decelerated through a fixed or adjustable method to reduce the impact and noise generated by sudden stops. There are two types:
Design considerations for fixed hydraulic cylinder cushioning devices include:

items: Prohibit excessive cushioning. The cushioning function should be able to set a shorter cylinder stroke length (also called cushioning stroke) to absorb the maximum kinetic energy of the cylinder.

sections.text: The load friction force directly reduces the output force of the hydraulic cylinder. According to the definition and calculation formula of the output efficiency, if the test shows the hydraulic cylinder at a certain pressure P₁ maintains the reciprocating motion state to detect the actual output, the formula P₁ = W + F₁ + F₂ is established, where P₁A is the theoretical output of the hydraulic cylinder, W is the actual output of the cylinder, F₁ is the friction force generated by the seal, F₂ is the resistance generated by other factors.

According to JB/T 10205—2010 (Hydraulic Cylinder), the output efficiency is η = W/(P₁A) × 100% ≥ 90%. If the result is the output efficiency that cannot pass the test, the friction resistance generated by the seal is also included.

4.1 Design and Selection Basis for Hydraulic Cylinders of Working Machinery

In JB 6030—2001 "General Safety Technical Requirements for Engineering Machinery", the engineering machinery products include: hydraulic press, shearing machine, bending machine, punching machine, shearing machine, furnace operation and lifting machine. Other engineering machinery products can also be used as reference. The design and installation of hydraulic cylinders and equipment, etc.

Note: Hydraulic press includes: push machine, shearing machine, bending machine, punching machine, shearing machine, self-propelled car, furnace car, lifting machine, return pressure machine, pressure machine, oil pump machine, water pump machine, etc.
4.1.1 Belt-type Hydraulic Press

This section involves the belt-type hydraulic press, which is a self-propelled belt-type machine. The working device can be installed with a push device, and the material is transported forward through the conveyor's front-end operation, pushing and moving flat materials, and also using the product's push force to guide the material device. In GB/T 35213—2017 "Hydraulic Press Belt-type Hydraulic Press Technical Conditions", the belt-type hydraulic press's scope and definition, classification, requirements, test methods, inspection rules and marks, packaging, transportation and storage, and use of hydraulic press with rated power 60~400kW hydraulic transmission, liquid pressure transmission and static pressure transmission belt-type hydraulic press (hereinafter referred to as hydraulic press), hydraulic press production products (such as hydraulic press, variable products, and cold-formed products).
1. Classification

items: Type and model designation

Type: The type of hydraulic press, according to the transmission method, can be divided into two categories: mechanical transmission type hydraulic press, hydraulic transmission type hydraulic press, and hydraulic transmission type static pressure hydraulic press.

sections.text: Model: The model of the hydraulic press should comply with JB/T 9725—2014 "Hydraulic Press Product Model Coding Method" regulations.
2. Parameters

items: Main parameters: The main parameters of the hydraulic press are the rated working pressure of the hydraulic cylinder, the basic parameters of the hydraulic press, and the basic parameters of the hydraulic cylinder should comply with GB/T 35213—2017 Appendix A, the basic parameters of the hydraulic cylinder should comply with GB/T 18577.1—2008 "Hydraulic Press Dimensions and Symbols" Part 1: Main and GB/T 18577.2—2008 "Hydraulic Press Dimensions and Symbols" Part 2: Working Device and Accessories regulations.

The coating appearance quality of the hydraulic press should comply with JB/T 5946—2018 "Engineering Machinery Coating Technical Conditions" regulations.

sections.text: Performance and Quality Requirements

items: The working environment temperature of the hydraulic press should be -15~-40°C, and the sea water should not exceed 2000m of the water depth under normal operation and operation. If special circumstances occur, it can be determined in the water depth and operation.

The rated pressure of the hydraulic press should not exceed 0.5%.

4.1.6 Automotive Lifting Machine

Automotive lifting machines are heavy-duty special-purpose lifting devices used on automotive chassis. They have the characteristics of large lifting capacity and fast lifting speed. In JB/T 9738—2015 "Automotive Lifting Machine", the definition, technical requirements, inspection methods, and standards for automotive lifting machines are specified. The lifting machine (hereinafter referred to as lifting machine) has various forms and can also be used for other purposes.
Technical Requirements
(1) Working Conditions

items: The parking ground should be solid and level. During operation, the ground must not sink, and the water level must be maintained in a horizontal state. The inclination of the supporting surface should not exceed ±5°.
During testing, the lifting machine should be placed on a level ground with all wheels off the ground to ensure the water level is horizontal and the inclination does not exceed ±5°.
The lifting machine's working load should comply with the regulations in the product manual, with a difference not exceeding ±5%.
The ambient temperature should be -20~40°C. If below -20°C, the product manual should be consulted.

The workshop wind speed should not exceed 14.1 m/s. When the wind speed exceeds 15.5 m/s, the lifting should be stopped. When the wind speed exceeds 20.0 m/s, the lifting should be stopped and the machine should be secured.
When the height exceeds 50m, the user should determine the wind speed, and the working wind speed should be determined accordingly.
The sea level should not exceed 2000 m.

1) The design, manufacture, and installation of the hydraulic system shall comply with GB/T 3766.
2) The hydraulic element must be able to withstand the maximum working pressure (including the pressure during the test). The hydraulic components shall comply with GB/T 7935.

The relative movement of the seal surface shall not exceed 100cm² or the oil discharge shall not exceed the oil.

10) The hydraulic soft tube shall comply with JB/T 8727. The safety factor shall not be less than 4. 11) The gear pump suction port vacuum degree shall not be less than 0.03MPa. The pump discharge port pressure shall not be less than 0.02MPa.

12) The hydraulic jack should have a liquid pressure circuit that is not exposed to external pressure. 13) In the intelligent device or near the intelligent device, the obvious position shall be marked with safety signs.

sections.text: 3. Test Method

items: The test sample shall be able to show the leakage part located in the test before the test is wiped clean.

① Place the leakage part at the lower end of the white paper on the test bench for easy observation.

sections.text: (2) Loss of Effectiveness Rules

items: For the first loss of effectiveness of the hydraulic cylinder, the number of losses is counted by the external and internal factors causing the loss; the loss count is not added to the effective count, and the test is interrupted and restarted.
If the second loss of effectiveness occurs and the two losses are directly related, the loss class is calculated without adding the count; if the loss is not directly related, the count is divided.
Once the effective count is determined, only one effective count is allowed, and the effective count can only be determined as one type.

In GB/T 36486-2018 "Electro-hydraulic proportional cylinders", the technical requirements for electro-hydraulic proportional cylinders are specified. Among them, for the structural design of hydraulic cylinders, the basic parameters such as rated pressure and sealing degree can be determined by the self-locking phenomenon (including lifting, active locking or running parts, etc.). At high speed, there should be no blocking phenomenon. The author considers this to be a manifestation of similar pseudo-locking capability.
The explanation is:

items: JB/T 3818-2014 and/or GB/T 36486-2018 are the general standards for various types of hydraulic cylinders, with general applicability and universality. 1) The spindle material shall be pressed and rotated 90°, and shall be able to ensure that the fixed position is perpendicular to the horizontal plane.

items: The pressing machine shall be equipped with mechanical safety devices to ensure the safety of workers.

items: Ambient temperature: 5–40°C. For non-heated environments (such as tents, steel structures) or cold environments, external insulation is required.
Relative humidity: At high humidity above 40°C, relative humidity should not exceed 50%. Hydraulic pumps can operate normally at temperatures below 40°C with relative humidity not exceeding 90%.
Altitude: Hydraulic pumps can operate normally at altitudes below 1000m.
Hydraulic pump operation and maintenance must comply with JB/T 1829 standards from the first use to major repairs.

sections.text: (2) Performance, Structure and Function

Hydraulic pumps must have sufficient rigidity. Under maximum load conditions, hydraulic pumps must operate normally.

Pump pressure must comply with composite technical requirements of the design. Rapid descent, precision control of load, return and other functions must be ensured.
3) Hydraulic Pump Control System

Hydraulic pump control systems should use proportional control technology. Position retention function should be provided. Hydraulic pump control systems can control the displacement of the pump head, pressure head, and multi-axis coordinated control to achieve precise multi-axis control functions.
5) Hydraulic Pump Sliding Friction Response
Hydraulic pump sliding friction response should be smooth, with reasonable hardness difference.
8) Hydraulic Pump Operating Response

Hydraulic pump operating response is fast and smooth. Hydraulic pump operation should be within specified speed and acceleration ranges without vibration, noise, and other phenomena. Reverse operation should not cause abnormal noise.
9) Hydraulic System Characteristics
Hydraulic systems should have targeted force load, oil temperature limit, oil position low-level alarm and other protective functions.
10) Hydraulic Pump Installation Requirements
Hydraulic pump installation requirements specify that upper material placement machinery, hydraulic pressure, pneumatic, electrical and other connections.

Hydraulic pump and matching auxiliary equipment connection should be coordinated and operable.

1) Hydraulic Pump Installation and Safety
Hydraulic pumps must be installed and fixed safely. Transportation and use should not pose hazards to personnel and must comply with GB 17120 regulations.

Hydraulic pump pneumatic and control safety requirements must comply with GB 5226.1 regulations.

Hydraulic pump noise must comply with GB 26484 regulations.

Hydraulic pump accessories should provide complete functionality and be equipped with devices for normal use. Special accessories should be supplied with dual-purpose or separate supply.

4.2.21  Medium-Thickness Steel Plate Pressure Flat Hydraulic Machine

The medium-thickness steel plate pressure flat hydraulic machine is a hydraulic machine that uses high-pressure liquid transmission for flat steel plate hydraulic machines. In JB/T 12510–2015, the basic parameters, technical requirements, test methods, inspection and verification rules, markings, packaging, transportation and storage are specified. The use of physical type pressure oil as the working medium for medium-thickness steel plate pressure flat hydraulic machines (hereinafter referred to as pressure flat machines).
1. Type and Basic Parameters
(1) Type
The basic structure of the pressure flat machine is based on the type shown in JB/T 12510–2015 Figure 1.
(2) Basic Parameters

2. Technical Requirements
(1) General Technical Requirements

items: The installation of the press cylinder shall comply with the technical requirements of JB/T 5000.10.

The press cylinder equipment shall be firmly fixed; the cylinder body, hydraulic transmission system (including pump stations, hydraulic pipes, etc.), electrical transmission and control systems (including control cabinets, operating platforms, wiring, etc.), mechanical equipment and accessories.
The main equipment components of the press cylinder should comply with the relevant standards specified in the handbook.

The working environment temperature of the press cylinder (including pump station) is 0~40°C, and the maximum (relative) humidity is 60%. If there are special working environment requirements, the technical specifications should be clarified.

The press cylinder shall be subjected to load test and acceptance within 2 months of use. In the event of a failure during the warranty period, the design and manufacturing defects shall be repaired or replaced at no charge (excluding man-made damage).
After the user receives the press cylinder, during normal use and maintenance, the first combined repair time shall be scheduled within 2500h. After that, the user shall use 4-6 years of maintenance.

The user shall be fully informed of the product knowledge, operation methods, and maintenance methods related to the press cylinder safety and economy. The information shall include relevant press cylinder safety technical documents and technical files.
The product description of the press cylinder should provide comprehensive product information to users.

sections.text: (2) Safety and Environmental Protection

items: The safety production design of the press cylinder shall comply with GB 5083 regulations.
The safety protection of the press cylinder shall comply with GB 17120 and JB 3915 (B-level) regulations.
The hydraulic transmission and control system of the press cylinder should have overpressure protection devices.
The electrical transmission and control system of the press cylinder shall comply with GB 5226.1 regulations.
The press cylinder and its mechanical equipment accessories shall be equipped with safety interlocks and engineering limit protection devices.
The press cylinder should be equipped with control operation platforms, control systems, and pump stations at multiple locations with emergency stop buttons.
The noise limit of the press cylinder shall comply with GB 26484 regulations.
The noise level and sound pressure level measurement method of the press cylinder shall comply with GB/T 23281 and GB/T 23282 regulations.

The waste discharge of the press cylinder shall be handled by qualified companies or environmental protection departments. Waste shall be disposed of in accordance with regulations, and shall not be arbitrarily dumped or discarded.

The press cylinder uses mineral oil-type hydraulic pressure as the working medium, which is a liquid that can transmit power and has hydraulic force and gas force devices. Therefore, the design and use of the press cylinder must comply with the fire safety standards of public hydraulic safety.

sections.text: (4) Main Technical Requirements for Key Components

1) The assembly machine includes upper and lower rigid surfaces and columns. Generally use JB/T 700 specified carbon structural steel plate welding structure. If welding is used, JB/T 5000.3 regulations should be followed. After welding, stress relief treatment should be performed. The calculated stress should be selected according to the material Rd value. Safety factor should be 2-2.5 (small liquid pressure machine limit, large liquid pressure machine limit). The chemical composition and mechanical properties of the material should comply with the selected material standard (standard). Check items and sample quantity should comply with JB/T 5000.8-2007 component inspection requirements in the first group classification.

2) The assembly machine columns generally use JB/T 699 specified carbon structural steel forgings, and should perform stress relief treatment. The calculated stress should be selected according to the material Rd value. Safety factor should be 2.5-3. Material chemical composition and mechanical properties should comply with the selected material standard. Check items and sample quantity should comply with JB/T 5000.8-2007 component inspection requirements in the first group classification and should test the material's Rd, Rp, A, Z, A4 values.

3) Columns and work columns generally use JB/T 6397 specified carbon structural steel forgings. Also use forged components welded method. Welding should be performed according to the calculated stress selection method. Material chemical composition and mechanical properties should comply with the selected material standard. Check items and sample quantity should comply with JB/T 5000.8-2007 component inspection requirements in the first group classification and should test the material's Rd, Rp, A, Z, A4 values.

4) Columns and work columns generally use JB/T 6397 specified carbon structural steel forgings. Also use forged components welded method. Welding should be performed according to the calculated stress selection method. Material chemical composition and mechanical properties should comply with the selected material standard. Hardness treatment should be performed. The work column hardness should not be lower than 48HRC, hardening layer depth should not be less than 3mm.

4) Product control should comply with JB/T 5000.2 regulations for cutting components.
5) Product welding components should be inspected for weld quality level as BK, BS grade, according to GB/T 11345 regulations for ultrasonic inspection.

sections.text: 3. Test Method
(1) Load Rotation Test
1) Load rotation test should be carried out after the pump is installed and debugged. Check its displacement, air content, temperature change, noise and other items.

3) Under 25MPa load condition, check whether there is oil leakage at the system connection, check whether the hydraulic and electrical system is sealed properly.
4) During load rotation, each pressure component, pipeline connection should not have oil leakage phenomenon. Oil tank oil level should not exceed 60°C.
5) During load rotation, the motor current should meet the specified requirements.
6) The pump noise should comply with GB 2644 standard.
7) After the test is completed, use self-priming method to continue load rotation test.
(2) Overload Test

Overload test should be carried out with safety valve set to adjust the test pressure. Increase the pump overload test pressure to 27.5MPa, test time not less than 3 hours. items: Check the power supply, start the motor, make the pump run at no-load. Check the motor current, motor oil pump starting characteristics and whether there is abnormal vibration and noise.

During the load operation test, the pressure head shall be in the left and right limit positions and the center position for load operation test. The load operation test shall comply with JB/T 3818—2014 Section 5.5 regulations and the following regulations:

During load operation, each liquid element, pipe and other dense parts shall not have oil leakage phenomena. The oil leakage shall not exceed the specified value.
During load operation, the moving position shall not have jamming, crawling and jumping phenomena.

The hydraulic press oil machine is a device that uses intermittent fixed stroke to make the material in the mold receive extrusion pressure and squeeze oil out. It is defined in GB/T 25732-2010 as a hydraulic press oil machine. The relevant technical activities, work principles, divisions, model and basic parameters, technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, marks, packaging, transportation and storage requirements are applicable to the total pressure not exceeding 200kN intermittent hydraulic press oil machine.
1. Working Principle

The hydraulic press oil machine uses the principle of leverage on the ship's board, so that the liquid is compressed by the pressure principle, so that the oil material is squeezed into the extrusion and oil removal, which is the hydraulic system and oil press machine body composition of a sealed return system.
2. Classification

items: 1) According to the different operation methods of the press: ① Direct hydraulic press oil machine, its active plate moves directly. ② Knee-type hydraulic press oil machine, its active plate moves horizontally.
