sections.text: 4.2.35  Oil Pump Direct Drive Double Rod Inclined Plane Self-Regulating Hydraulic Machine

Self-regulating hydraulic machine is a high-pressure hydraulic transmission device used for hydraulic transmission. Used for self-regulating hydraulic machine in the first product standard JB/T 12229—2015 defined oil pump direct drive double rod inclined plane self-regulating hydraulic machine type and technical parameters, technical conditions, test methods, inspection test scope, standards, packaging, transportation and storage. Apply to the following product type hydraulic oil work separation of oil pump direct drive double rod inclined plane self-regulating hydraulic machine (hereinafter referred to as double rod inclined plane self-regulating hydraulic machine).
1. Type and Technical Parameters
(1) Type

Double rod inclined plane self-regulating hydraulic machine frame has two basic types, namely rod inclined plane type corresponding to force combined frame and double rod inclined plane type corresponding to force combined frame. Main (side) rod drive type is divided into transmission type and lower transmission type, also can be divided into force combined frame, and "rod" type of rod inclined plane frame. 2. Technical Requirements
(1) General Technical Requirements
1) The general technical conditions for the use of double-column hydraulic press machines should comply with JB/T 1829 and JB/T 3818.

2) The equipment range of double-column hydraulic press machines includes: the hydraulic cylinder body (including the cylinder head conversion and supply device), the hydraulic drive and control system (including pump stations, operation valve and pipe system), the electrical transmission and control system (including control cabinet, operation platform and cable), the cooling system, special tools, upper and lower cylinder head binding, and other necessary auxiliary equipment.

3) The mechanical equipment and attachment devices of double-column hydraulic press machines (such as electron-controlled mobile devices, fixtures, copper-clad wire lifting combined steel wire rope transmission, etc.) and their most important work equipment (such as various shaped fixtures, wire rope combined with equipment product specifications, etc.) can be selected according to actual production requirements.

4) The working environment temperature of double-column hydraulic press machines (including stations) should be 5-40°C, and the relative humidity should not exceed 85%. The sea level should be less than 2500m. If there are special working environment requirements, it should be specified in the technical agreement.

5) The negative load test of double-column hydraulic press machines should be carried out for 12 hours per day. In the case of normal use and normal working conditions, if the design and manufacturing defects cause the original failure to occur, the relevant modifications or equipment changes should be made (except for easy operation and removal).

6) After the double-column hydraulic press machine is put into use, in the case of normal use and maintenance to ensure the working conditions, the first comprehensive maintenance should be performed after 2850 hours or 6 months of use, whichever comes first.

7) The product manual of double-column hydraulic press machines should provide product information, and should be consistent with the planned functional adaptation of the product use method, including the relevant safety pressure machine safety information, and with the sample and technical documents. This information should have the responsibility to prevent risks, reduce maintenance costs and extend the service life of the hydraulic machine, and improve the reliability of the hydraulic machine.
(2) Safety and Environmental Protection
1) The safety design of double-column hydraulic press machines should comply with GB 5083.
2) The safety protection of double-column hydraulic press machines should comply with GB 17120 and JB/T 3915 (discontinued).
3) The hydraulic transmission and control system of double-column hydraulic press machines should be equipped with safety protection devices.
4) The electrical transmission and control system of double-column hydraulic press machines should comply with GB 5226.1.
5) Double-column hydraulic press machines should be equipped with mechanical equipment safety interlocking control and protection devices.
6) Double-column hydraulic press machines should be operated on the operation platform, and the control system should be positioned to prevent accidental operation.
7) The noise of double-column hydraulic press machines should comply with GB 26484.
8) The noise level and pressure noise level of double-column hydraulic press machines should comply with GB/T 23281 and GB/T 23282.

9) The waste liquid disposal of double-column hydraulic press machines should be entrusted to professional companies for recycling and treatment, or in accordance with local environmental protection requirements, to prevent environmental pollution and avoid random discharge.
10) Double-column hydraulic press machines should use mineral hydraulic oil for processing.

The working medium is a hydraulic pressure transmission device that directly transmits the pressure generated by the pump and carries oil pressure and gas pressure equipment. Therefore, the hydraulic machine design must use protective measures that meet and comply with protective safety standards. In addition, the following points should be noted:

items: The oil-carrying charging valve should not allow air and other inert gases to enter, and should be installed below the oil surface.

The charging valve outlet should be connected to the corresponding quick-disconnect isolation valve or the charging valve's body should be equipped with a quick-stop air valve, and should be equipped with a safety stop lock to prevent accidental opening.
The pressure relief valve on the pressure relief pipeline should be able to correctly adjust and set the pressure, and the adjustment should be sealed to prevent liquid leakage.
Liquid pipes, hoses, and fasteners should be designed to withstand the pressure they may encounter.
The hydraulic machine oil tank, hoses, joints, valves, and other equipment should be designed to prevent oil leakage.
All work stations, pump stations, valve blocks, and pipe equipment should be equipped with oil collection devices.

sections.text: 4.2.37 Hydraulic Type Universal Testing Machine

The hydraulic type universal testing machine uses a hydraulic system to apply force to conduct experimental testing methods. In GB/T 2611-2007 (Testing Machine), the basic requirements for the testing machine are specified, and the configuration of mechanical safety, mechanical work, casting and welding are defined.

Equipment, electrical equipment, hydraulic equipment, external dimensions, dimensional accuracy and technical documents, etc. are applicable to metal material testing machines, non-ferrous material testing machines, universal machines, vibration tables, impact testing machines and related testing machines, force measurement instruments, deformation measurement instruments, and strain measurement instruments (hereinafter referred to as testing machines).

Methods: The testing machine may be a universal testing machine, a special testing machine or a combination of the above testing machines. The testing machine can be of various types: liquid pressure type, electronic type, electro-hydraulic servo type, and can determine the tensile strength, compressive strength, bending strength and shear strength of materials; it can conduct material tensile tests under temperature changes, the so-called "cold and hot (or hot) tests", and can conduct tests beyond the scope of work.
Regarding hydraulic equipment (i.e., GB/T 2611-2007 Chapter 8), the following requirements are specified:

items: The hydraulic system foundation, hydraulic tank, and valve port surfaces should not have cracks and damage.
The hydraulic transmission part should be in the working speed range within the specified range and should not have vibration, impact and leakage phenomena.
The hydraulic system should have an exhaust device that can seal, and there should be no leakage phenomenon.

Oil pipe connections and hose connections should meet the following requirements: ① Under normal working conditions, the system should be able to allow the full flow of oil from the system; ② Prevent leakage and discharge of polluted hydraulic fluid back to the oil tank. ③ The oil tank section should be able to prevent liquid oil from being discharged from the tank. ④ The oil tank should be convenient for cleaning and should have oil level and oil temperature indicators. ⑤ The oil tank should have oil level indicators.

The hydraulic system should adopt water-proof and moisture-proof measures. To eliminate hydraulic fluid contamination, the system should be equipped with a filtration device with a specified cleanliness level. For any return circuit, the system should be equipped with a filter that can prevent liquid oil from being discharged into the return oil port.
The filtration device installation should be reserved with sufficient space for easier replacement.
All return pipes should have oil return filters installed at the outlet to prevent air bubbles and water from entering the oil.
When the hydraulic system circuit is working at a flow rate exceeding the specified limit, a protective device should be provided.
The hydraulic transmission part should be equipped with a working position switch.
When the hydraulic system has one or more mutually related automatic or manual control devices, if one control device fails, it should have a protective device.

The hydraulic system should be positioned with the oil inlet, pipe and pipe elements to prevent liquid oil and oil return from being drawn into the equipment or causing environmental hazards. A protective device should be provided to prevent liquid oil from being drawn back into the oil return pipe.

The electro-hydraulic servo-driven static performance testing machine uses an electro-hydraulic servo/proportional control system. It can apply static force, as well as apply force with an electronic universal/fatigue testing function. In JB/T 8612-2015, the types, designations, and specifications of electro-hydraulic servo static performance testing machines are specified, including: test machine main parameter series, technical requirements, inspection methods, marking, packaging and shipping, and applicable materials including metal and non-metal materials. 4.3.4 Numerical Control Plate Bending Machine

According to GB/T 34376-2017, the basic definition of numerical control plate bending machines is: machines that use numerical control systems to control the hydraulic plate bending machine's sliding block and/or material positioning, where the hydraulic plate bending machine's bending is driven by the proportional relationship between electric and hydraulic pressure, and through position feedback from sensors to detect and correct deviations, controlling the bending pressure of the numerical control hydraulic plate bending machine. The driving mechanism of the numerical control hydraulic plate bending machine is a machine (or hydraulic pressure) method to ensure the bending of the numerical control hydraulic plate bending machine. In GB/T 34376-2017, the definition of numerical control plate bending machines' basic language and meaning is required: precision, test method, inspection standards, and marks; in GB/T 33644-2017, the definition of numerical control plate bending machine precision inspection requirements, calibration inspection methods, and application of numerical control (hydraulic pressure) plate bending machines (hereinafter referred to as numerical control bending machines) are specified.
1. Requirements
(1) Drawings and Technical Documents
The sample technical documents of numerical control plate bending machines shall comply with the specified standards and shall be produced according to the specified production method.
(2) Type and Parameters
The basic type and parameters of numerical control plate bending machines shall comply with JB/T 2257.2.
(3) Spare Parts and Matching

items: Numerical control plate bending machines shall maintain their integrity and completeness during normal use and maintenance, and shall have matching spare parts for special components used by users and manufacturers. The same specifications shall be randomly selected or independently ordered.

The manufacturer shall ensure that the external conditions (including gas, liquid, and working elements, etc.) of the numerical control plate bending machine match the implementation standards and obtain their compliance, and shall conduct joint commissioning tests with the machine.

sections.text: (4) Safety and Protection
The safety and protection of numerical control plate bending machines shall comply with GB 28243.
(5) Rigidity
The rigidity of numerical control plate bending machines shall comply with the technical documents.
(6) Slider Stop Position

The working structure of the numerical control plate bending machine's slider shall be coordinated with the operating structure. When an operation is completed, the slider should be positioned at the lower dead point.
(7) Markings

Numerical control plate bending machines shall have nameplate and instruction markings, and the operation shall comply with safety requirements. The nameplate and markings shall comply with GB/T 13306. The shape and symbols on the nameplate shall comply with JB/T 3240, and the nameplate shall be firmly fixed at a suitable location.
(8) Castings, Forgings, and Welded Parts

items: Gray iron castings shall comply with JB/T 5775. Ductile iron castings shall comply with GB/T 1348. Welded parts, forgings, and colored metal castings shall comply with the relevant technical documents in the design sample. All defects shall be eliminated. Under the premise of ensuring measurement accuracy, technical documents are permitted to be used for defect repair.

Forgings, forgings, connecting rods, work platforms, shafts, active shafts, active rods, adjustment screws, templates, and other necessary castings shall be subjected to stress relief and heat treatment.

sections.text: (9) Machining

items: All parts shall be machined in accordance with design, process, and relevant standard requirements. The surface shall not have burrs, cracks, and other mechanical damage. Except for special specifications, the average surface roughness shall be controlled.
The main guide rails, guides, sliders, shafts, active shafts, and other main friction surfaces shall be subjected to stress relief treatment.

sections.text: (10) Electrical Equipment Numerical Control System

items: The electrical equipment of numerical control plate bending machines shall comply with GB 5226.1.

4.4.3 Six-Cylinder Piston Cooled Motor
The six-cylinder motor is a horizontal piston motor with six cylinders arranged in a circle. The upper and lower work cylinders are arranged in a circle to form a complete bearing.

Mainly used for oil-immersed copper plate control and rail steel piston motors. In JB/T 11593-2013 "Six-cylinder cooled motor" the specifications of the six-cylinder cooled motor structure type, basic parameters, technical conditions, test methods, inspection and packaging, and application of six-cylinder piston motors (referred to as six-cylinder motors) are specified.

4.5.1  Metal Cutting Machine Tool Hydraulic Pressure System

In GB/T 23572—2009 (Metal Cutting Machine Tool Hydraulic System Technical Requirements, Installation Requirements, Safety Requirements, Test Methods, Inspection Rules and Other Requirements), it is stipulated that the technical requirements, installation requirements, safety requirements, test methods, inspection rules and other requirements for metal cutting machine tool hydraulic systems are applicable to hydraulic transmission and control systems using pressure oil as the working medium for metal cutting machine tools.
1. Technical Requirements

items: Basic Requirements: The hydraulic system design, control and use should comply with GB/T 3766 regulations, ensuring that the equipment has a long service life and is easy to maintain.
Hydraulic Components: The hydraulic system should use hydraulic components that comply with GB/T 7935 regulations, and all components should meet the relevant standards.

Hydraulic Oil: The hydraulic oil used in the system should comply with GB/T 3766 and GB 7632—1987 (Machine Tool Hydraulic Oil) regulations. The hydraulic system should be equipped with a filter to prevent oil contamination. The hydraulic oil should be added to the hydraulic system tank without exceeding the specified level.

Pipes, Joints and Passages: (1) The hydraulic system pipes should be made of seamless steel tubes or hoses. Pipe materials should be corrosion-resistant and have a wall thickness that can withstand the maximum working pressure of 1.5 times the rated working pressure. (2) The hydraulic system should have a filter at the inlet to prevent leakage. Seals and other joints can use sealing rings or sealing gaskets, but rubber and asbestos substitutes cannot be used. (3) Oil passages should be processed smoothly, without sharp edges or burrs. Short shaft diameter should not be less than 0.75. (4) Before installation, pipes, joints and passages should be cleaned (including internal and external surfaces), and fine debris should be stored separately. The sealing surface of the tank should not have any damage, scratches, rolling or other defects.

sections.text: 5) The hydraulic system's oil passage should meet the requirements of the specified flow rate.

6) Pipe installation should be safe and orderly, arranged neatly, and use one-piece pipes. For maintenance and replacement, avoid pipe bending. To prevent vibration and noise during long-distance pipe operation, use clamps to fix the pipes at intervals. Each pipe should be separated from other pipes at a certain distance. See Table 4-166 for specific values.

sections.caption: Table 4-166  Pipe Spacing

items: 7) Pipes should not be welded to pipe ends, nor should they be fixed to pipe paths.
8) Pipes should not be supported by support elements or bearing oil plates.

9) Soft pipes should use movable joints at both ends and be fixed to components with greater displacement. The length should be as short as possible to avoid equipment vibration during operation. Soft pipes must be protected to prevent damage and deformation.
10) Pipes should be firmly installed and have high reliability to ensure personnel safety and load-bearing capacity.
11) Pipes should be marked with pressure pipes, control pipes, return oil and drain pipes using different marks.
12) Pipe connections should have marks to facilitate disassembly and recovery.

13) Liquid System Tank: (1) The liquid system tank name should comply with JB/T 7938—2010 (Hydraulic Tank) requirements. (2) During the working cycle, the oil level should be maintained at a safe height. The tank should have sufficient space to prevent oil splashing and separation of air. In normal conditions, the tank should be able to store all the oil returned from the system. Prevent oil leakage and contamination of the oil by dust. (3) Under the condition of component matching, the hydraulic pressure of the tank should be increased to above 150mm above the oil surface to facilitate heating. (4) The tank cover can be placed in its structure to prevent dust from entering the oil tank. (5) Use a flow filter or other device to filter the oil into the hydraulic pressure tank outlet. Adopt measures to prevent the tank from being washed. (6) The shape of the oil tank opening should facilitate the liquid level gauge. The tank should be equipped with an oil level gauge, drain hole, filler hole, and drain hole. The drain hole should be placed at the lowest position in the tank. The oil should be stored in one or more openings above the oil surface to facilitate cleaning of the oil tank interior.

sections.text: 7) Ensure that the oil inlet filter has a return seal, and the return oil circuit eventually returns to the oil tank at the lowest position.
8) The outlet should be equipped with a liquid level gauge, and the air-oil interface of the oil tank should be equipped with a breather.

9) Oil tank materials should meet the oil liquid capacity requirements. For copper-lined oil tanks, the inner surface treatment should use acid pickling and passivation, shot blasting, shot peening and other chemical and physical methods to ensure the stability of the material, and can also be coated with oil-resistant corrosion-resistant anti-rust coating.
(6) Pressure gauge

items: The hydraulic system should be equipped with a pressure gauge for safe operation in a location that is easy to observe.
The pressure gauge range should be 1.5–2 times the maximum working pressure.
The pressure gauge should generally be equipped with an overpressure device, or use a damping pressure gauge, and an external damping device can be added.
When measuring multiple pressures, a multi-point pressure gauge or a selector valve composed of multiple check valves can be used to measure multiple points.

sections.text: 2. Installation requirements

items: The pipeline and main engine separation parts of the hydraulic system should be signal-marked and numbered, with labels and related technical documents consistent.

The safety of the hydraulic pump inlet should be ensured, the pump inlet and motor shaft alignment should be checked, and the shaft runout should be φ0.05mm; the elastic coupling shaft runout should be φ0.1mm.
The assembly and transportation of the pump should comply with the requirements of GB/T 3766.

sections.text: 3. Safety requirements

items: The design, manufacture and use of hydraulic systems must comply with the safety requirements of GB/T 3766.

The operating personnel should be trained in the operation of the hydraulic system to ensure safe operation of the hydraulic system. Generally, static pressure gauges should be used to ensure that the hydraulic system can drive the liquid system to complete its mechanical movement. A static pressure gauge should be installed to ensure safe operation.
When the hydraulic system loses its normal pressure capacity, the system should be equipped with necessary alarm devices, indicator signals and protective measures.
The hydraulic pump should be equipped with an electric motor brake to prevent the pump from rotating when power is lost.
When the operating platform is equipped with a capable liquid return circuit, it should be able to automatically relieve pressure on the capable device or isolate it.

When the operating platform is equipped with a pressure relief circuit that needs to use a capable device, the capable device should be equipped with a pressure relief device. When there is pressure liquid in the working circuit of the capable device, the capable device should be equipped with a pressure relief device. The instruction manual should indicate 'Note: Pressure relief' with the word.
All equipment with a rated pressure of 15kg of the part or equipment should be able to prevent the equipment from being installed or lifted.

4.5.3  Machine Tool (High Speed) Rotary Hydraulic Cylinder

In Reference [15], the typical structure of hydraulic cylinders is described, covering both general-purpose hydraulic cylinder typical structures and special-purpose hydraulic cylinder typical structures and applications.

Barrel-type rotary hydraulic cylinder typical structures include gear-rack rotary hydraulic cylinder, piston-type barrel rotary hydraulic cylinder, vane-type rotary hydraulic cylinder, rolling rotary hydraulic cylinder, and single-cylinder rotary hydraulic cylinder (five types). It also states that: 'Piston rotary hydraulic cylinder is a hydraulic cylinder combined with a rotary mechanism. The rotary mechanism usually consists of gear-rack or helical groove type. This is a type of component that combines the hydraulic cylinder and hydraulic motor functions. The output of the rotary hydraulic cylinder is rotation, and the rotation angle is generally within the 0°-360° range.'

Based on testing or reference materials, refer to Reference [15] for barrel-type hydraulic cylinder typical structures. The differences between barrel-type hydraulic cylinders are described below, noting that column-type hydraulic cylinders and barrel-type hydraulic cylinder structures differ. The following describes column-type hydraulic cylinder and rotary hydraulic cylinder structures. The hydraulic cylinder body and piston rotation are driven by external components, not generated by the hydraulic cylinder itself.

sections.text: (3) Test Method
1) Test Conditions
① The hydraulic accumulator can be installed on the machine tool, or it can be tested on a test bench.
② Test time ambient temperature starting temperature range is 5~40°C.
③ Hydraulic oil uses GB/T 3141—1994 ISO viscosity grade 32 or 46 hydraulic oil.
④ Hydraulic oil has anti-foam and anti-rust ability.
⑤ Hydraulic system is equipped with a filter with precision of 20μm.
⑥ Pressure gauge range should not be less than 1.5 times the maximum working pressure.
⑦ Balance valve used for connection device, the maximum pressure difference should not exceed 20% of the test pressure.

2) Test pressure: When oil temperature is not lower than 25°C, measure test pressure. Hydraulic cylinder starting pressure should comply with (2)(3) regulations, keep constant speed throughout the process, no phenomenon.

3) Temperature: Hydraulic cylinder continuous rotation, when reaching thermal equilibrium (thermal equilibrium is when hydraulic cylinder oil temperature rises within 10min and does not change more than 1°C), measure hydraulic cylinder oil temperature on the outer surface, should comply with (2)(4) regulations.
4) Measurement: At force of 75% of maximum working force, oil temperature at 50°C, use volume method from return hole to measure oil volume per minute, should comply with (2)(5) regulations.

5) Maximum push and pull force: At static state, maximum working pressure, use dial gauge to measure hydraulic cylinder maximum push force and maximum pull force, should comply with (2)(7) regulations; also record the calculated value.
Hydraulic cylinder maximum push force (4-12) calculation:
F_Tmax = (p_max - 0.25) × S_t
In the formula: F_Tmax—maximum push force, unit is N; p_max—maximum working pressure, unit is MPa; S_t—piston push area, unit is mm².
Hydraulic cylinder maximum pull force (4-13) calculation:
F_Lmax = (p_max - 0.25) × S_L
In the formula: F_Lmax—maximum pull force, unit is N; p_max—maximum working pressure, unit is MPa; S_L—piston pull area, unit is mm².
6) Equilibrium: When performing hydraulic cylinder equilibrium test, pre-check the connection device installation pressure gauge position accuracy, make its axial radial runout not exceed 0.01mm.
Hydraulic cylinder performs dynamic equilibrium test, the lower pressure after the piston moves down should be installed on the test machine spindle.

Hydraulic cylinder equilibrium test measurement of the remaining unbalanced force should comply with GB/T 9239.1—2006 requirements to calculate dynamic equilibrium quality grade, should comply with (2)(8) regulations.
7) Operation test:
① Hydraulic cylinder maximum working force below, medium, high speed continuous rotation, each level rotation speed not less than 10 rotations, each level rotation speed not less than 2min.
② Do not use pressure below, with extreme rotation speed continuous rotation 1h, according to (2)(9) regulations.
③ Observe hydraulic cylinder pull force change, record hydraulic cylinder pull force change, push force should remain unchanged.

4.7 Ship hydraulic cylinder design and selection basis
4.7.1 Ship hydraulic system

In CB/T 1102-2008 "Ship hydraulic system general technical requirements", it stipulates the requirements of ship hydraulic system, the relationship between main and auxiliary hydraulic systems, applicable to ship machinery and equipment hydraulic transmission and control systems, including all auxiliary equipment hydraulic system design and construction.
1. Design
(1) Design principles

items: Hydraulic system design should consider personnel safety and possible accidents, and adopt the following safety measures:
① Limit pressure, limit position, limit.
② Overload protection.
③ Reduce system impact pressure, prevent pressure shock and induced danger.
④ Improve system back pressure.
⑤ Ensure liquid reservoir absorption capacity.
⑥ Oil filtration degree should comply with various elements in the system requirements.
⑦ Has alarm signal, such as position, oil temperature high and low, filter blockage, loss of pressure, pressure gauge, etc.
⑧ Clarify the operating rules for the use of working oil quality and performance.
⑨ System pressure source and circuit must ensure safe and effective operation. If pressure relief valve, pipeline blockage, liquid cylinder movement or lock mechanism, etc.
⑩ Establish safe operation procedures and set up operation process signs.

sections.text: 2) System working temperature and element allowable use temperature should match.
Matching requirements:

items: System design should avoid overheating.
When the system oil passes through, use the system oil cooler (air cooling or water cooling).
When the system oil passes through, use the system oil heater (electric heating or steam heating).
In low ambient temperature conditions, if the oil viscosity is too high, use oil circulation heating method. After heating to a certain temperature, it can be put into operation.
Elements and pipelines should be arranged to avoid small leaks in the production and transmission.
Should take measures to prevent noise and vibration of elements, such as elastic connection, shock absorber, soft pipe, etc.
For easy oil leakage environment, should set up collection facilities to prevent oil leakage from polluting the environment.
Equipment should be arranged in a state that is easy to disassemble and assemble; when disassembling the system, do not remove large sections of piping or equipment.
When performing maintenance work, do not cause large loss of working oil.
Remove non-system required work oil, maintenance oil tank generally should not be used.
Need to adjust, replace and regularly clean the oil filter elements in the system.
In the system at the position of the position device release point or drain point, pay attention not to form air pockets.
Heavy items exceeding 15 kg of elements, parts or equipment should be lifted or placed.

sections.text: (2) Elements and auxiliary

items: The load of the hydraulic cylinder, the stroke installation should not have common lateral force.
The push-pull port direction of the hydraulic cylinder should be arranged.

② In the working system circuit to improve the liquid sample for pressure shock pollution analysis, should be analyzed according to GB/T 17489 regulations.
③ Working oil without system time should pass through filtration, and filtration accuracy should not be lower than system requirements.
3) Sealing and sealing.

O-ring rubber seal ring should comply with GB/T 3452.1 requirements.

(1) General Requirements

items: The system shall clean all hydraulic pressure components and components at each outlet, and install blind plates, sealing plugs, etc. If reverse flow is found, timely inspection shall be ensured.

All pipes (including cleaning pipes) shall be chemically cleaned.

Pipes that do not meet the requirements of chemical cleaning shall use cleaning oil method to clean the pipes, and use pipe plugs to seal the outlet, and use the corresponding working oil for circulation.
When the ship is sealed with hydraulic system, compressed air shall not be used to clean, and shall prevent spray and other possible pollution of the system.
The assembled components on the equipment (including assembled blocks) and systems shall be pre-cleaned before installation, and shall be sealed at the outlet.
Before ship installation is completed, perform final cleaning.
Cleaning shall use pressure pump, filter and oil tank and other equipment.
When setting the return path, the bypass pipe shall be connected back to the tank, and shall not use cleaning oil circulation liquid tank, control element and working element, etc.
When setting the return path, it can be divided into one or several circuits according to needs and convenience.

(2) System Oil Flushing

items.text: 1) Clean using high-pressure pump circulation. The flushing liquid should be circulated through the system at a flow rate corresponding to the system's working flow, but it is recommended that the flushing pressure of the pressure group be maintained at no more than 4000.
2) Use a filter.

items: The filter accuracy should be based on actual conditions, and begin flushing through at least 150–200 times the filter element capacity. After this step is completed, the final cleanliness level should meet the system requirements and be consistent with the design cleanliness level.
Use a bypass filter.
Use a filter with equipment suitable for on-site inspection and replacement.

items.text: 3) Flushing oil.

items: The flushing oil should match the working oil used in the system.
The flushing oil should be of low viscosity.
If using working oil for flushing, filter the oil before use and do not use it in the system afterward.
Do not use chemically synthesized cleaning agents.
Oil temperature.

Recommend hot oil flushing. When the temperature of the flushing equipment and working oil reaches the specified value, the maximum oil temperature should not exceed the specified value. Maintain the oil temperature at 50°C.
Do not use hot oil flushing or increase the oil temperature.
Do not repeatedly add oil.
Operational requirements.

Flushing should be performed in sequence and multiple times through the pipeline without light tubes (or other effective methods). Special attention should be paid to the connection position or tube end.
After system flushing is completed, disassemble the filter and check the time interval between disassembly and the first inspection.
The time interval for disassembling the flushing filter should be extended, with a maximum interval of 1h.
The total flushing time interval should be determined based on the return line length and complexity, with a general interval of 10–24h.
Flushing can be performed using clean dry nitrogen pressure or nitrogen-filled systems, with nitrogen purity and flushing oil use.

4.7.2 Ship-use Reciprocating Hydraulic Cylinders

GB/T 13342—2007 (Ship-use Reciprocating Hydraulic Cylinder General Technical Conditions) Standard specifies the technical requirements and inspection rules for ship-use reciprocating hydraulic cylinders. See Table 1-30.
1. Classification
(1) Type
Common ship-use hydraulic cylinders are divided into two types below:

items: Rod-type pressure cylinder: The rod is a single-acting cylinder with external extension movement, and the reverse stroke is completed by external force.
Double-acting piston cylinder: The piston rod and piston move in both directions, and the external extension and contraction strokes are both powered by hydraulic force.

sections.text: (2) Basic Parameters
The basic parameters of hydraulic cylinders are specified in GB/T 13342—2007 or Table 2-14.
(3) Graphic Symbol
The graphic symbol of hydraulic cylinders shall comply with GB/T 786.1.
2. Requirements
(1) Appearance

items: Hydraulic cylinders shall not have hair burrs, cracks, rust spots, and other defects, and shall be free of sand holes and pores.
Hydraulic cylinder outer surfaces shall not have cracks, deformation, leakage, and other defects.

External metal surfaces shall be treated with anti-rust treatment, and shall use a rust-preventive coating layer. The coating layer shall be uniform and smooth, and the coating time shall not be less than the anti-rust period. Recoat if necessary.
Hydraulic cylinder outer surfaces shall be coated before applying anti-rust paint, and rust spots shall not be visible.

sections.text: (2) Material
1) The main materials of hydraulic cylinders shall be selected according to Table 4-189, and may also be selected according to the materials specified in Table 4-189.

sections.caption: Table 4-189 Main Material Requirements

sections.text: 2) After 100% non-destructive testing of the cylinder, it shall meet the Class I requirements specified in JB/T 4730.3—2005 (as amended).

items: Hydraulic cylinders shall generally be equipped with end caps, and the rod end shall be free of metal burrs.
Hydraulic cylinder rods shall use connecting bolts, and the bolts shall be less than GB/T 3098.1—2000 Class 8.8.
Hydraulic cylinders shall generally be equipped with end caps and air vents.
Hydraulic cylinders, piston rods, or piston rods shall have anti-corrosion measures.

sections.text: 5) Welding strength shall not be lower than the strength index of the base material. Welding quality shall comply with GB/T 3323—2005 Class I requirements.

(4) Temperature: The temperature requirements for hydraulic cylinders shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007 or Table 2-67.
(5) Working Medium: The working medium of the hydraulic cylinder body shall have a fixed viscosity index not lower than GB/T 14039—2002 —/19/16.
(6) Pressure Resistance: The pressure resistance of hydraulic cylinders shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007 or Table 2-67.

(7) Tightness: Hydraulic cylinders shall withstand 1.25 times the rated working pressure. The gap between the inner and outer surfaces shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007 Table 2 or Table 2-159 requirements, and shall not have external leakage.
(8) Internal Leakage: The internal leakage of double-acting piston cylinders shall not exceed the specified value in GB/T 13342—2007 Table 2 or Table 2-159.
(9) External Leakage: The external leakage of hydraulic cylinders shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007 or Table 2-67.

(10) Minimum Starting Force: 1) The minimum starting pressure of the basic hydraulic cylinder shall not be less than GB/T 13342—2007 Table 2-67 requirements. 2) The minimum starting pressure of the double-acting piston cylinder shall not exceed the specified value in GB/T 13342—2007 Table 4 or Table 2-158.
(11) Minimum Stable Speed: The minimum stable speed of hydraulic cylinders shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007 or Table 2-67.
(12) Load Efficiency: The load efficiency of hydraulic cylinders shall not be less than 90%.
(13) Corrosion Resistance: The corrosion resistance of hydraulic cylinders shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007 or Table 2-67.
(14) Internal Cleanliness: The internal pollution level of hydraulic cylinders (at 1 hour operation) shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007 Table 5 requirements. See Table 5-15.

The test methods for hydraulic cylinders shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007.
4. Inspection Rules
The inspection rules for hydraulic cylinders shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007.

(1) Marking
The marking of hydraulic cylinders shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007. See Table 2-324.

The packaging requirements for hydraulic cylinders shall comply with GB/T 13342—2007.

5.1 Test Methods for Hydraulic Cylinders
5.1.1 GB/T 15622—2005 'Hydraulic Cylinder Test Methods' Summary and Application
1. Summary

GB/T 15622—2005 'Hydraulic Cylinder Test Methods' was issued on July 11, 2005 and implemented on January 1, 2006. It replaces GB/T 15622—1995 'Hydraulic Cylinder Test Methods'. This standard is not replaced by JB/T 10205—2010 'Hydraulic Cylinders' in terms of regulatory application, and is also applied to some hydraulic cylinder products that meet the standard. To apply this standard, the following provisions in the standard should be noted:

items: Scope: This standard specifies the test methods for hydraulic cylinders.
This standard applies to hydraulic cylinders (including working cylinders and tie rod cylinders) used as working media for liquids (liquids) with a viscosity range of 5×10⁻⁶ to 110×10⁻⁶ m²/s.
This standard does not apply to combined hydraulic cylinders.

3. Application of Hydraulic Cylinder Test Items and Methods
When using the test items and methods specified in the standard, the following points should be noted:
(1) Endurance (Test) Pressure Force

In endurance pressure tests, the test pressure (test) pressure force has different definitions for each standard, such as public pressure force, rated force, public working pressure force, rated working pressure force, etc. Only "public pressure force" and "rated pressure force" are defined in GB/T 17446-2012.
The public pressure force or rated pressure force is expressed by the endurance pressure force, which has fixed values. Other values may also be generated.

In Table 5-10 listed standards, the test pressure (test) pressure force is defined as "1.5 times the public pressure force" as the highest. The endurance pressure force in the hydraulic transmission system is based on the load pressure force. Generally, the endurance pressure force is below, only the rated pressure (rated) test. The endurance test is a static test. For other tests, the endurance test is static, and for dynamic tests, the endurance test cannot be performed.

The critical point is not very important. In hydraulic cylinder testing, the rule of "output test pressure 10s" is the most scientific. For example, if the nominal pressure is 1.5 times the rated pressure of 2 min, it is necessary to maintain the required pressure of 5 min. If the test pressure drops below the specified value during the test, it cannot be repaired.

"Nominal pressure" and "rated pressure" are also used in sealing tests. Without this, the hydraulic cylinder's sealing performance test pressure does not match the static sealing pressure output by the test pressure. Therefore, after the hydraulic cylinder outputs the test pressure, the static sealing pressure output by the test pressure should be managed. Otherwise, the hydraulic cylinder outputs the test pressure, and the static sealing pressure output by the test pressure should be managed.
(2) Active and Passive Rods

The active and passive rods are relative to the hydraulic cylinder (cylinder). The active rod can move back and forth with the cylinder, and the active rod and cylinder rod shaft are integrated. In some hydraulic cylinder test standards, the relationship between the cylinder (cylinder) and the fixed state is described by the rod (cylinder) interval placement description. This description method is necessary, but the active rod inside the cylinder (cylinder) is not necessarily the same as the passive rod (cylinder). Large-scale hydraulic cylinder internal leakage test requirements require "the tested hydraulic cylinder to be active and sealed, separated by the working pressure of the cylinder", measure the active sealing leakage at the end of the test. 1. Purpose and Application
(1) Purpose
This test is to obtain relevant data to evaluate the high temperature performance of the equipment.
(2) Application

This test applies to equipment used in high temperature environments. The effects on the safety, reliability and performance of the equipment are analyzed according to the technical documents. The equipment should be tested according to GJB 4239—2001 (Equipment environmental test requirements) to obtain the results and determine the equipment distribution (location).
(3) Restrictions

This test uses a time-limited evaluation method (the number of days is not the number of years). The test equipment heats up and distributes the expected effect, generally not suitable for: a) Evaluation of the periodic stiffness of the ground exposed to high temperature conditions (due to the type of situation under which it may be possible to cause some creep effects). This kind of high temperature chemical response should use natural environment for evaluation. b) Evaluation of the thermal expansion response caused by solar radiation, because the solar radiation will generate high temperature in the equipment. The direct radiation effect should use GJB 150.7A—2009 for evaluation. c) Evaluation of photochemical response (photochemical response should use GJB 150.7A—2009 program II for evaluation). d) Evaluation of the effect of heating.

According to GJB 150.15A—2009 (Environmental Test Methods for Military Equipment) Test Method 15 (Acceleration Test), the standard applicable to the corresponding equipment should be used for the pressure gauge acceleration test with reference values.
1. Purpose and Application
(1) Purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify:
a) Equipment structure can withstand the acceleration caused by platform vibration and rapid acceleration, and can reduce the reliability degradation during operation and use.
b) Equipment can withstand vibration without causing danger.
(2) Application
This test is applicable to equipment installed on aircraft, helicopters, ships, and other vehicles.
(3) Limitations

items: Acceleration level: The acceleration level specified in this test should not exceed the rated acceleration. If the rated load does not meet the definition, the acceleration analysis, design, and test method should be redesigned.

Dynamic loading: When the equipment is in flight, vibration exposure on the equipment surface, in addition to bearing static load, it also receives dynamic load. The test is not suitable for this type of situation. Equipment bearing dynamic load should be tested according to these loads. Impact test: impact is a type of rapid movement that can cause equipment to change shape (common vibration). However, the impact test method is different from the acceleration test method, and vice versa.

Chapter 6 Remanufacturing of Hydraulic Cylinders
6.1 Overview of Hydraulic Cylinder Remanufacturing

According to existing standards, remanufacturing is a series of industrial processes performed on discarded (or waste) products to restore them to like-new condition, making the remanufactured products have the same quality characteristics and safety performance as new products. The remanufacturing process generally includes remanufacturing material collection, inspection, disassembly, cleaning, classification, evaluation, repair and processing, reassembly, and inspection (testing), identification and packaging.

Remanufacturing is guided by the circular economy concept of "reuse" in a high-level form. It is both the innovation of manufacturing and also the economic model of the era. The goal of remanufacturing is to divide the remanufactured products into different levels of remanufacturing and upgrade the remanufactured products.

According to the remanufacturing goal, remanufacturing can be divided into two categories: (1) Restoring remanufacturing is the recovery of remanufactured cylinder quantity and safety performance remanufacturing mode. (2) Upgrading remanufacturing is the remanufacturing of cylinder E-rings with technical improvements, new designs, improved or upgraded quality characteristics and safety performance remanufacturing mode.

Based on relevant literature and information, remanufacturing technology originates from manufacturing and maintenance technology. Remanufacturing has the following characteristics: (1) Advancedness: The remanufacturing process adopts advanced original product design and manufacturing technology, advanced inspection technology, advanced labor technology, etc. (2) Innovation: The remanufactured object is the discarded product of the previous generation. It does not use the same environment, does not have the same effect mode, requires remanufacturing to be based on the foundation of traditional manufacturing, continuously adopts new methods, new equipment, and shows dynamic characteristics, thereby solving product reliability problems. (3) Measurability: The basic requirement of remanufacturing is to fully restore the performance of discarded products. It is the production method with the highest degree of industrialization and quality assurance system integrity. According to regulations, from the enterprise obtaining certification, the remanufactured products should meet the standards specified in the relevant standards (to be announced), and the remanufactured products should be inspected according to the relevant standards to ensure the quality of remanufactured products reaches the level of promoting supervision and use.

(4) Economy: Remanufactured waste (or waste) products, if they cannot be reused, reduce the number of discarded items, greatly reduce the consumption of raw materials and auxiliary materials in the production process, reduce environmental pollution, extend product service life, and save resources. For hydraulic cylinders, due to the quality characteristics (generally including product function, technical capability, green nature, economy, etc.) of the products, the technical capability, green nature, and economy of the remanufactured hydraulic cylinders are more prominent.

Regarding the remanufacturing industry development of hydraulic cylinders, the key areas for further investigation and improvement are: "Notice on Promoting the Development of the Remanufacturing Industry" (2010) No. 991 "Opinions on Promoting the Development of the Remanufacturing Industry".

items: Waste hydraulic cylinder remanufacturing shall comply with relevant national standards for resource utilization, environmental protection laws and regulations, and relevant standards.

Profit rate (Rc) is a parameter that evaluates the profit of remanufactured products. It is the ratio of the net profit obtained from the sale of remanufactured products to the total cost of the original product, that is:
Rc = (Ro / Rc) × 100%
Formula (6-4): Where Ro is the net profit obtained from the sale of remanufactured products; Rc is the total cost of the original product.
2) Price Recovery Rate
Price recovery rate (Rpc) is the ratio of the price of recovered hydraulic accumulators and their components to the total value of remanufactured hydraulic accumulators, that is:
Rpc = (Rpc / Rpc) × 100%
Formula (6-5): Where Rpc is the value of recovered hydraulic accumulator and its components; Rpc is the total value of remanufactured hydraulic accumulators.
3) Environmental Recovery Rate

Environmental recovery rate (Renv) is the ratio of the environmental pollution avoided by remanufactured products through direct environmental protection to the net profit obtained from the sale of remanufactured products, that is:
Renv = (Rsk + Rp) / Rc × 100%
Formula (6-6): Where Rsk is the direct environmental benefit; Rp is the indirect environmental benefit; Rb is the net profit obtained from the sale of remanufactured products.
4) Addition Efficiency

Addition efficiency (Radd) is a parameter that measures the time saved in the remanufacturing process. It uses the waste hydraulic accumulator and the actual remanufacturing time to calculate the average addition time compared to the original product manufacturing time, that is:
Radd = (Tc / Tsc) × 100%

Formula (6-7): Where Tc is the average remanufacturing time of the waste hydraulic accumulator; Tsc is the average manufacturing time of the original hydraulic accumulator. The addition efficiency evaluation must consider the production equipment, product performance and cost factors. When calculating the addition efficiency, analysis, selection, and clarification should be carried out based on actual conditions.
(3) Environmental Evaluation Parameters
1) Material Rate

Material rate (Rmat) is a parameter that evaluates the material quality of remanufactured products. It is the ratio of the weight of remanufactured material to the total weight of the hydraulic accumulator, that is:
Rmat = (Wrem + Wre) / Wg × 100%
Formula (6-8): Where Wrem is the weight of remanufactured components; Wre is the weight of directly reused material; Wg is the total weight of the hydraulic accumulator.
2) Energy Efficiency

Energy efficiency (Ren) is a parameter that evaluates the energy efficiency of remanufactured products. It is the ratio of the waste heat energy recovered from the waste hydraulic accumulator to the total energy consumed in the remanufacturing process, that is:
Ren = (PWwad - PWwm) / PWwad × 100%

Formula (6-9): Where PWwad is the waste heat energy recovered from the waste hydraulic accumulator; PWwm is the energy consumption of the remanufactured hydraulic accumulator. The advanced remanufacturing technology can improve the energy efficiency.
3) CO2 Reduction Rate

CO2 reduction rate (Rco2) is a parameter that evaluates the reduction of CO2 emissions from the remanufactured hydraulic accumulator. It is the ratio of the reduction of CO2 emissions to the total CO2 emissions from the waste hydraulic accumulator, that is:
Rco2 = (Ewad - Ec) / Ewad × 100%

Formula (6-10): Where Ewad is the CO2 emissions from the waste hydraulic accumulator during the waste treatment process; Ec is the CO2 emissions from the remanufactured hydraulic accumulator. The advanced remanufacturing technology can reduce CO2 emissions.
4. Remanufacturing Evaluation Process
(1) Failure Mode Analysis of Waste Hydraulic Accumulators
1) The failure mode of waste hydraulic accumulators should be analyzed and the remanufacturing plan should be evaluated based on the failure mode analysis.

2) The failure mode analysis of waste hydraulic accumulators should be divided into the following categories: the original product cannot be repaired due to wear (wear report), the product performance cannot be restored due to corrosion (corrosion report), the product performance cannot meet the standard due to contamination (contamination report), the product cost is not acceptable (cost report).
(2) Hydraulic Accumulator Remanufacturing Impact Factor Analysis

1) The remanufacturing performance of hydraulic accumulators is a comprehensive technical parameter that cannot be evaluated by a single factor. The technical factors and economic factors should be considered comprehensively.
2) Different technical processes should be considered for the remanufacturing of hydraulic accumulators, and the economic and environmental service performance should be analyzed.

3) Re-design the pressure resistance of the hydraulic cylinder to re-manufacture the hydraulic cylinder that does not have certain functional requirements, can meet the requirements of the application market. Re-design the pressure resistance of the hydraulic cylinder to ensure that the re-design technology method is established, and also reflects the environmental and economic requirements.

4) The application should meet the requirements of re-manufacturing to ensure that the conditions of equipment, personnel technical level, technical application conditions, production conditions, etc. are met.

5) The application should have technical, economic, environmental requirements, adopt the method of loss mode prediction analysis and physical test correlation combined method, carry out the description 3 (1) and (2) to determine the quantitative evaluation coefficient. sections.text: 6.4.4 Remanufacturing of Hydraulic Cylinders Surface Repair and Remanufacturing Technical Specifications

Remanufacturing of hydraulic cylinders refers to the surface repair and remanufacturing technology of remanufactured cylinders (remanufactured cylinders) to carry out surface repair. The remanufacturing of hydraulic cylinders involves a series of engineering technologies, which also includes the expansion of remanufacturing technology.

Remanufacturing of hydraulic cylinders can be divided into different sub-methods, such as surface repair and remanufacturing combined with environmental protection combined remanufacturing technology, mechanical combined remanufacturing technology, plating/semi-mechanical combined remanufacturing technology, chemical combined remanufacturing technology and management combined remanufacturing technology; if the remanufactured cylinder is divided by the degree of damage, it can be divided into layered damage remanufacturing technology and accumulation damage remanufacturing technology; if divided by repair method, it can be divided into welding repair technology, brush plating repair technology, surface coating repair technology and adhesive repair technology.
1. Design and Selection Principles
(1) Applicability Principle

1) The repair layer should be remanufactured with materials that have good physical and chemical properties in the management, chemical and mechanical properties required for the repair work, and the repair work should have a good effect on the remanufactured cylinder shape, size, and performance and other effects, and should comply with relevant technical requirements.

2) According to the control of the repair layer hair of the original service environment, affected by the state, working conditions and effective mode, etc., comprehensively consider the repair layer should have the strength, rigidity, environmental resistance and structural characteristics, select the appropriate surface repair technology and materials.
(2) Economic Principle

Under the premise of meeting the remanufactured cylinder quality and performance requirements, comprehensively consider the technology to reduce costs, process flow remanufacturing degree and remanufactured economic indicators, give priority to the use of automatic chemical remanufacturing technology, and should be simplified chemical process.
(3) Environmental Protection Principle

When selecting surface repair technology, should reduce resource consumption, energy consumption and environmental pollution; in the repair work design and material selection, should focus on achieving zero waste discharge or extended service life of waste.
2. Requirements
(1) Basic Requirements
1) Remanufactured hydraulic cylinders should be surface repair and remanufactured with priority to environmental protection work, equipment, and material rental methods.
2) After repair, the remanufactured hydraulic cylinder should not be lower than the original product type new product
Dimensional accuracy, technical parameters, material properties and compliance with functional requirements.
(2) Restoration Requirements

1) The seal pressure gauge and its mating surface should be restored to their original working state, with effective sealing and functional requirements met. Remanufacturing should be carried out based on remanufacturing design, considering technical, environmental and economic feasibility, determining remanufacturing technical methods and process flow, and formulating remanufacturing industry guidance documents, ensuring surface restoration classification, structure and related functional properties and academic functional indicators.

2) The seal surface restoration technical requirements should be based on the requirements of the original design. For seals manufactured according to GB/T 32809, inspection should comply with GB/T 31208 regulations.
(3) Restoration Process Requirements

1) After restoration, the seal pressure gauge and its mating surface restoration layer should be inspected, with inspection content, methods, and solutions consistent with relevant technical document specifications.

2) The seal surface restoration design should undergo necessary dimensional and hardness measurements to ensure restoration position accuracy and overall dimension accuracy, with priority given to non-destructive testing methods. If seal testing is required, sealed surface testing should be performed.

3) The seal pressure gauge restoration quality should meet the requirements for the degree of combination, residual stress inspection should be prioritized using non-destructive testing methods that comply with relevant standards.
4) The seal pressure gauge restoration test should be conducted as required, such as sealed surface testing.
5) Seals should be properly stored to prevent restoration seal components from being released during transportation, storage, corrosion, and deformation.

sections.text: Nano-composite brush plating technology is not only a new technology in surface engineering, but also a key technology for manufacturing precision ceramic materials. It is a new method. Nano-composite brush plating technology is a combination of nano technology and traditional brush plating technology, which not only maintains the functions of brush plating, electroplating, chemical plating and other technologies, but also expands their application scope and has gained wider and stronger applications.
(1) Improving the wear resistance of part surfaces

By adding nano-ceramic particles into the plating solution to carry out nano-composite brush plating, when nano-ceramic particle powder is dispersed in the base metal coating, it forms a full metal-ceramic composite coating. The brush plating coating contains a large number of nano-ceramic hard particles, making the brush plating layer highly wear-resistant. Using this kind of brush plating can replace the processes of chrome plating, carburizing, nitriding, and hard chromium plating, etc.
(2) Reducing the surface roughness of parts

By adding nano-scale particles with reduced friction (such as nano-diamond particles, molybdenum disulfide, graphite, etc.) into the brush plating solution for nano-composite brush plating, the obtained composite coating has a low friction coefficient. This type of nano-composite brush plating solution with dispersed nano particles distributed within it has the characteristic of several individual reduced areas reaching the effect of reducing friction of parts, and can also reduce the wear of parts and extend their service life.
(3) Improving the high-temperature wear resistance of part surfaces

By adding metal-ceramic powder brush plating coating material into the nano-composite brush plating, particularly the metal-ceramic coating which has excellent high-temperature resistance. When the brush plating layer is working at high temperatures, the ceramic phase can maintain high-temperature stability, and the brush plating layer as a whole can also serve as support, effectively improving the high-temperature wear resistance of the brush plating layer.
(4) Improving the fatigue resistance of part surfaces

Many surface engineering techniques require plating layers, which can also be used to restore damaged part dimensions and geometric shapes, improve part surface corrosion resistance, wear resistance, and can withstand alternating loads. Nano-composite brush plating layers have relatively high fatigue resistance.

properties, because nano-composite brush plating contains thousands of nano-sized solid particles deposited in the weak areas of the coating, equivalent to placing many position control lines with no number of "limiting posts". This "limiting post" can effectively limit the crystal within the coating as a type of internal stress. The existence of this also changes the stress state of the crystal. Therefore, the nano-composite brush plating layer has excellent fatigue resistance, which is far superior to ordinary brush plating layers.
(5) Improving the service performance of metal surfaces

Many parts or workpieces are made from or use metallic coatings, mainly to achieve good electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, corrosion resistance, anti-fouling and other properties. The forming process is to create a colored metal intermediate layer (liquid plating, copper alloy brush plating treatment may turn green, brass color) (solid silver plating), which can all be applied using this technology.
(6) Practical aspects of re-manufacturing are mainly focused on brush

The focus of the re-manufacturing process is to first determine the original part dimensions and geometric tolerances. Therefore, the traditional brush plating method is used first for rapid restoration of the plating layer to the required dimensional tolerance on the part surface, and then nano-composite brush plating technology is used for dimensional correction on the surface brush plating layer as the working layer, to improve the part surface properties. Using brush plating or brush plating + brush plating nano-composite coating repair and supplementation on parts (such as scratches, pitting, cracks on journal, piston rod, etc.) is a fast and meaningful technology.

sections.text: In solvent composite electroplating, important process considerations include: 1) Plating voltage: Due to the large amount of salt particles contained in the solvent electroplating solution, the plating voltage is generally lower than that of conventional electroplating. Usually, when the work pressure is small, the work temperature is low or the plating time is short, the plating voltage is lower. In the solvent composite electroplating process, the plating voltage rises over time (approximately 10-20s) before dropping to normal plating voltage.

2) Plating temperature: In the solvent composite electroplating process, the work temperature should be maintained at room temperature. This way, the plating of the workpiece can be maintained at a constant state, ensuring that the liquid circulation degree is uniform, the plating particles are fine, and the internal stress of the solvent composite plating is small, resulting in higher bonding strength.

For more detailed information, refer to relevant technical documents. In the solvent composite electroplating process, the plating temperature should not be lower than 15°C, and preferably not higher than 50°C. 3) In the solvent composite electroplating process, the relative motion speed between the work and the electrode is generally 6-10m/min. When the relative motion speed is too fast, it is easy to cause plating defects; when the speed is too slow, it is easy to cause uneven plating thickness and may cause the composite plating layer to peel off. The dissolution of the composite plating layer is large, and it is easy to cause layer separation, wrinkles, and surface defects. The position of the workpiece should be changed during the plating process to prevent loss of effectiveness.

sections.text: Surface coating repair technology (also known as surface adhesion technology) is a method of applying high-polymer composite materials (such as epoxy, two-component polyurethane, metal-filled coatings, ceramic-filled coatings, fiber-reinforced composites) mixed into composite adhesive coatings on the worn or damaged surface. It uses special adhesives (such as sealing, corrosion resistance, wear resistance, insulation, conductivity, protection, anti-static, crack repair and dimensional recovery) as a surface coating technology.

Surface coating repair technology process is simple, with repair layer thickness adjustable, and will not cause local heat distortion. However, when used for cracks, damage, dimensional deviation and surface roughness recovery, it is necessary to use surface repair adhesive with explosive hazards (such as oil-containing equipment) to avoid safety hazards. This technology is safe and reliable, requires no special equipment, has high production efficiency, is a fast repair method with good economic benefits, and has broad application prospects.
Surface coating repair process steps:

items: Initial cleaning: Initial cleaning is mainly to remove rust, dust, and oil stains on the worn surface. Use mechanical cleaning, rust removal, and final cleaning with solvent.

Pre-processing: To ensure the repair has a certain degree of adhesion, the surface must be mechanically processed. The depth of the worn surface repair is generally 0.5-3mm. To prevent coating layer delamination, 1-2mm edges should be left on the worn surface. The coating layer should be applied to form a 'mushroom shape' to increase the adhesion strength of the coating layer.

Final cleaning and activation treatment: The final cleaning can be done with two-stage cleaning; if there is oil at any time, it can be cleaned with adhesive on the surface, and then mechanical cleaning, chemical treatment, and high-temperature cleaning can be used to remove surface oxidation.

Matching and coating: The coating material should be selected according to the working conditions. For best results, the coating material ratio must be strictly controlled. After mixing, use immediately.
Adhesive coating: Coating construction follows the coating method, coating layer printing method, and mold forming method.

Curing: The coating layer's curing degree is related to environmental temperature. Generally, the coating layer is cured at room temperature for 24 hours to reach high strength in 7 days; if the temperature is 80°C, curing time is 2-3 hours. After curing, the surface can be cleaned or processed with a file, knife, or other tools to remove excess adhesive. The coating surface has holes less than 1mm, use internal corrosion-resistant cleaning first, then use adhesive repair, and finally dry cure.
For coatings requiring continuous processing, the coating layer can be processed or ground after curing.

1. Overview of thermal spray repair technology concepts
(1) Basic concepts and characteristics of thermal spray repair technology

Thermal spray repair technology (referred to as thermal spray technology) is a technology that uses heat source or material energy source (combustion, electric arc, etc.) to heat and melt materials to semi-melting state, in high-temperature gas flow under the action of spray to the substrate surface, forming a multi-layer structure and achieving remanufacturing of hydraulic cylinders.

Remanufacturing surface repair technology. Thermal spray is a product remanufacturing method, which cannot be used to restore the product to its original size, can improve the surface quality of parts, has been widely applied in equipment repair and maintenance, producing significant comprehensive benefits. Thermal spray has the following characteristics:

1) Selection of thermal spray coating materials should be based on the working conditions, and materials containing metals, alloys, ceramics, and plastics should be selected according to the substrate material. The coating layer has multiple functions, including wear resistance, corrosion resistance, heat resistance, oxidation resistance, thermal shock resistance, electrical insulation, sound insulation, and sliding friction resistance.

2) The thermal spray coating material and the increase in temperature have a high influence, the speed is large, the material type is diverse, the powder structure is complex, the spray method is diverse, and other factors are related.
3) Suitable for various substrate materials, such as metals, ceramics, glass and other inorganic materials, wood, paper and other organic materials.
4) The thermal effect on the substrate is small, the coating layer thickness can be controlled, but the surface flatness is lower.
5) The coating layer is mainly lamellar structure, with residual stress of 30-40MPa.
6) The thermal spray coating layer is usually lamellar structure, with residual stress, incomplete melting of particles, oxide film, and other defects.

Reference document [110] mentions that when using spray coating repair methods for porous holes, due to the repair layer being in the hole base, the shrinkage during cooling causes the repair layer to crack. Therefore, this method is not suitable for repairing porous holes in hydraulic cylinders.

(2) Thermal spray coating base material and classification. According to the coating method, in the thermal spray process, the coating material undergoes the following process: heating → acceleration → oxidation → re-acceleration → impact base → cooling and solidification → forming a layer, the entire process is divided into three stages:

items: The coating material is heated, accelerated, and melted.
The melted material is heated (flow state), and gradually accelerates to form a particle flow; the particle melting rate increases.
Particles are deposited on the substrate surface, causing deformation, condensation, and bonding.

sections.text: The thermal spray coating material is classified according to its shape, including powder, wire, and belt materials; classified by composition, including single materials, composite materials; classified by function, including wear-resistant, heat-resistant, oxidation-resistant, corrosion-resistant, and other functional coating materials.

(3) Thermal spray coating process flow and key points. The thermal spray coating process is as follows: substrate surface treatment, including surface cleaning, degreasing, rust removal; application of various coating methods for thermal spraying; post-treatment, including hole drilling, mechanical processing, heat treatment, etc.

2. Plasma Ion Spray Coating Repair Technology
(1) Plasma ion spray coating equipment. Plasma ion spray coating equipment mainly includes the following parts:

1) Plasma ion spray gun. It is mainly composed of a non-rotating electrode separation plasma ion source, which is the core device in the plasma ion spray equipment. The plasma ion spray gun has the following characteristics: pure control of thermal properties, stable spray, and the use of rare earth electrodes (nitrogen content of 2%-3%).

2) Powder feeder, which is the powder feeder in the plasma ion spray equipment. It collects water, electricity, gas, powder, and the most critical parts are the spray gun and electrode. The spray gun has a guiding thermal property of pure control, and the electrode uses rare earth electrodes (nitrogen content of 2%-3%).
2) Power source. Use power supply for direct current, which is generally a full-wave rectified silicon rectifier circuit. Common rated power levels are 40kW, 50kW, and 80kW three specifications.
3) Powder feeder. Use lime powder storage tank without powder discharge during work. Requirements for powder feeder: adjust the powder feeding method flexibly to adapt to the powder moisture content.
4) Heat exchanger. Mainly used to make the powder obtain sufficient cooling effect, achieving the goal of using water circulation system.
5) Gas supply system. Use compressed air supply system.
6) Control equipment. Use PLC for control, with corresponding adjustment and control of the powder coating process.
(2) Factors affecting powder coating quality
In the powder coating process, the factors affecting coating quality are numerous, but the main process parameters are:

1) Inert gas. Use inert gas to carry powder and gas. Gas purity requires not less than 99.9%. Gas selection should be based on possible hazards and economy. Inert gas price is convenient, high transmission speed, good fluidity, and beneficial to powder addition and oxidation. However, it is easy to cause oxygen reaction of powder or substrate that cannot be used; ionized (charged) inert gas is easy to induce, prone to small or large powder spraying. Ionized gas has very good protective effect, but ionized gas price is high.

The large direct impact of gas flow on the heating and flow rate of inert gas powder, from affecting coating efficiency, coating layer pore and porosity, etc. If the gas flow is too large, the gas will be equal to inert gas in the powder, and the powder particle size will be insufficient, reducing the powder particle size in the inert gas 'suspension' interval, causing coating particles to not reach the required position. The coating must be hard and brittle, with low density and hardness, and the accumulation rate is also low. Conversely, if the gas flow is too small, it will make the inert gas pressure insufficient, and the large low coating particle size. sections.text: 1. 激光熔覆修复技术

Laser cladding repair utilizes high-energy-density laser beams to melt the cladding material and substrate surface, and after rapid solidification and cooling, forms a metallurgical bond between the cladding and substrate. This is a laser processing technology that combines high efficiency with low surface modification. By adopting laser cladding technology, it is possible to restore the shape and size of worn parts, and make the cladding layer have excellent corrosion resistance, wear resistance, and oxidation resistance. It is a highly efficient surface modification technology that can be widely applied in the repair and remanufacturing of hydraulic cylinders.

According to different laser cladding material feeding methods, laser cladding can be divided into powder feeding laser cladding, wire feeding laser cladding, and precoated laser cladding. Among these, powder feeding laser cladding is the most commonly used method. It uses YAG (solid-state laser with yttrium aluminum garnet) or CO₂ laser as the heat source, and uses a coaxial powder feeding nozzle or lateral powder feeding nozzle. Laser cladding can also be classified as single-track laser cladding, multi-track laser cladding, and multi-layer laser cladding based on the cladding pattern.

The laser cladding repair material selection should consider two aspects: the working conditions of the hydraulic cylinder and the control parameters of the laser cladding process. According to GB/T 29796-2013 standard specifications for laser cladding repair technology, the selection of laser cladding repair materials should be based on the working conditions of the hydraulic cylinder, and the laser cladding process parameters should be selected accordingly.

Laser cladding repair materials mainly include powder materials, wire materials, and sheet materials. Among these, powder materials are the most widely used. Currently, laser cladding powder materials are mostly supplied in the form of hot spray coating or self-fluxing powder materials. The main materials used include self-fluxing nickel-based, cobalt-based, and iron-based powders, which can meet the requirements of different working conditions.

In order to ensure good quality of the laser cladding layer and excellent performance, it is necessary to select appropriate cladding materials based on the design requirements or select cladding materials with similar properties to the original material. When selecting cladding materials, the expansion coefficient of the cladding material and the base material should be considered to be close, and the humidity and other factors should be controlled to ensure the quality of the laser cladding repair.

For laser cladding to achieve quality control, laser cladding layer quality control should focus on reducing laser cladding layer defects, preventing laser cladding layer surface pollution, and preventing cracks and pores. Laser cladding process parameters should be set to ensure repair quality and component quality inspection according to relevant standards.

According to reference [86], laser welding is commonly used to add metal to worn or eroded surfaces by laser melting. It uses laser heating to melt the base material and added metal simultaneously, allowing the base material to be heated and melted together, achieving metallurgical bonding. Laser cladding after supply and cooling obtains a base metal with metallurgical bonding (welded) overlay on the surface, making the component surface recovery meet external dimensional requirements, and the surface coating is strengthened. Laser forming welding repair (repair) technology has the following basic principles and technical characteristics: laser light forms welding repair, solving the problem of vibration welding, gas tungsten arc welding, plasma welding, and other repair work with no fundamental solution to material utilization limitations.
