The so-called coal mining hydraulic support column and jack cylinder bore laser cladding remanufacturing technology refers to the remanufacturing of columns and jacks whose chrome plating layer has peeled off, corrosion damage and other damage resulting in failure, by using laser cladding technology on stainless steel material to achieve or restore the original quality level of a new product.

According to simulation test results, the service life of laser cladding repaired columns used as the outer surface of hydraulic support columns should be 6 times the service life of the original chrome-plated columns.

According to DB 37/T 1932-2011 regulations, the column and jack bottom should mainly be cleaned of rust, oil stains, degreasing treatment, and judged suitable for remanufacturing based on the following conditions. Those judged not suitable for remanufacturing:

items: a) For cylinder bodies, the gap between the small column seal and the mating surface radial depth should not exceed 2mm.
b) For cylinder bodies, the gap between the small column seal and the mating surface should not exceed a radial depth of 2mm.
c) Cylinder bodies with cracks, cracks at the cylinder end threaded connection or other connection parts that are incomplete.
d) The straightness deviation of the cylinder bore inner hole is greater than 0.05%; the cylindricity deviation is greater than 0.2% of the nominal dimension.
e) The straightness deviation of the piston rod is greater than 0.1%.

For the outer cylinder body, the cylinder body, piston rod welding seam grade should meet GB/T 6402, GB/T 5777 requirements and pass ultrasonic flaw detection. If the outer cylinder body and cylinder body damage depth, width, and circumferential extent are severe, it is necessary to use laser cladding or electroplating process to repair the cylinder bore interior, meeting technical requirements.

Laser cladding remanufactured stainless steel column sleeve requirements: The laser cladding layer thickness should be no less than 0.5mm. After laser cladding, the surface hardness should be no less than 40HRC, and after pressure treatment the surface hardness should be no less than 42HRC. The cladding layer should be uniform and flat, with no cracks, no blistering, no peeling, no spattering or loosening, and should be free from scorch marks; the sealing groove and sealing surface should have no pitting or other external defects.
(1) Application of laser cladding technology on coal mine hydraulic support columns.

The hydraulic support column oil cylinder laser cladding necessity is described in reference [125]. The introduction states that Shanxi Xishan Mining Group's hydraulic support columns are large in size, with various types of jack repairs - one type uses electroplating technology. Based on environmental protection requirements, electroplating and chrome plating have been phased out by many factories over the years. The chrome plating price continues to rise, already becoming an alternative to hydraulic support columns. Jack repair restoration uses this method. Moreover, electrochrome plating cannot meet the needs of coal mine users, especially in environments with H₂S gas or acidic gas (or acidic mine water). The laser cladding layer's service life is 5 times that of electroplated chrome layers.

Currently, most domestic high-pressure hydraulic support columns use laser cladding repair. After laser cladding repair, the next repair timing is only when a casting defect or spot point appears, and the repair method is to apply a complete repair to all areas with base material removed, reducing time, labor costs, environmental pollution, and after laser cladding repair, under a single support column, the production time is reduced, large area columns do not need fracture treatment, and only need to re-clad the damaged point areas, significantly reducing time, costs, and environmental impact.

2) Using electroplating and laser cladding repair capabilities, the electroplating process involves depositing metal on the base material to form the plating layer or changing the base material surface to achieve chemical modification. Due to the harmful nature of the process, it is prone to pollution, easy to crack, easy to peel. The plating process also uses a combination of mixed alloys and additional hardened composite coating layers. The plating layer thickness is generally 0.05-0.06mm. The plating layer's hardness is relatively low. When subjected to pressure, shock or impact, the plating layer is easily scratched and cracked. In laboratory conditions, moisture in the air will pass through tiny cracks in the coating base material, and the coating will gradually deteriorate over time, resulting in the formation of reduced area coverage, with rust and corrosion spreading under the surface, thereby generating more surface area loss.
3) Economic analysis: According to research findings, laser cladding process cost is 3189.5 yuan/m², while electroplating process cost is 1450

yuan/m². Electroplating requires nickel pre-plating followed by chrome plating during each major repair, and laser cladding repair only requires small area patching during major repairs, so the laser cladding process saves significantly on subsequent maintenance costs. This effectively solves the problem of battery bottle neck issues encountered in the repair process of large support columns and jacks of various kinds.
(2) Application of Stainless Steel Powder Laser Cladding Remanufacturing Technology for Hydraulic Cylinder Rod Components

According to reference [126], an introduction and field investigation show that a certain hydraulic support bracket must be used in an environment where natural weather and harsh conditions prevail, resulting in high corrosion susceptibility. The hydraulic cylinder rod extends to its full stroke during operation, and is prone to bending and deformation. Due to overload, the piston rod's working condition is poor, and since there is excessive super-travel, the rod body surface shows peeling. Due to excessive stress, the rod body and seal bearing area are damaged, causing the seal to fail completely. Under the condition that the hydraulic cylinder rod is pressed, the cylinder sealing becomes tight, and if the grease is too much, the rod surface will appear to have two-thirds of the outer coating removed, and the coating material will remain on the rod surface.

The spray welding method is adopted. Due to chromium plating's hardness and ability to resist impact not being satisfactory, the laser cladding approach is used to improve the surface hardness of the hydraulic cylinder body rod. Stainless steel-based laser cladding remanufacturing process is applied to the hydraulic cylinder body rod's surface. The surface hardness, surface roughness reduction, and durability are improved, thus improving the service life of the hydraulic cylinder body's useful working range. Cost-effective economic benefits can be obtained.

Laser cladding of hydraulic cylinder rod components with stainless steel powder for restoration is a type of high-energy laser beam cladding process that achieves non-deformation of the area without causing heat distortion of the material. The process of reaching the surface hardening technique involves the basic principle of using a high-power density (10³-10⁵W/cm²) laser beam to irradiate the hydraulic cylinder rod surface. The irradiated surface layer area is rapidly heated to above the phase transformation critical temperature, and when the surface temperature of the workpiece reaches a temperature below the melting point, the stainless steel powder coated on the surface of the rod begins to melt. Due to the extremely fast cooling of the substrate, at a large temperature gradient, the heated zone rapidly cools from the austenitizing temperature. Since most of the workpiece acts as a heat conductor, the stainless steel melt rapidly solidifies. When the laser beam stops irradiating, the heated zone rapidly cools (10⁶-10⁸°C/s), and the substrate itself acts as a two-directional cooling medium, producing metallurgically bonded layers on the outer surface.
Using this stainless steel cladding remanufacturing technology to restore hydraulic cylinder rod components has the following characteristics:

items: 1) Laser beam provides rapid heating, self-cooling, no need for insulation and cooling treatment. It is a non-polluting green environmental heat treatment process. It can easily achieve laser cladding repair of the hydraulic cylinder rod surface.
2) Due to the fast laser heating speed, the heat-affected zone is small, which is surface scanning heating, so the repaired hydraulic cylinder rod deformation is minimal.

3) Due to the small laser beam divergence angle, it has good directionality, and can precisely guide the optical system to achieve local precision surface processing of hydraulic cylinder rod surfaces.

7.1.2 Cleanliness indicators required for hydraulic systems and components

The cleanliness indicators for hydraulic system components should comply with the relevant provisions in the product standard. The product standard specifies the main cleanliness requirements for hydraulic components and component cleanliness indicators according to JB/T 7858–2006 (Cleanliness rating determination method and hydraulic component cleanliness rating standard). The cleanliness level of the hydraulic system (according to GB/T 14039) should be determined based on the control requirements of the hydraulic system. Some hydraulic systems require cleanliness levels as high as possible to minimize the sensitivity of hydraulic system components to contamination, such as proportional and servo control hydraulic cylinders. However, some hydraulic system cleanliness or contamination levels require classification by system (work) pressure level.

The specified cleanliness level for a group of symbols is represented by numbers in the form of a fraction, with the first group symbol representing the number of particles greater than 5μm in the full-flow oil (calculated as particles per milliliter), and the second group symbol representing the number of particles greater than 15μm in the full-flow oil (calculated as particles per milliliter). 7.1.3 Flushing and Filtration of Pipelines and Working Interfaces in Hydraulic Systems

The cleanliness level of hydraulic system pipelines will directly affect the performance of the hydraulic system. If the cleanliness level cannot be ensured during the assembly and commissioning process, solid particles contaminating the working fluid will be generated in the hydraulic system, and fixed contamination of the working fluid will occur in the hydraulic system. To reduce this type of blockage, the hydraulic oil and hydraulic system surface must be flushed and cleaned to achieve the specified (standard) cleanliness level.

The biggest danger of hydraulic oil temperature being too high is that the hydraulic oil itself will eventually decompose, and the ability to maintain hydraulic oil viscosity and lubrication will be reduced. Various organic compounds may be deposited in the hydraulic oil in the form of oil sludge or paint (oxidized particles) such as asphalt, resin, carbon and other polymer compounds. These resinous and viscous substances may cause valves to stick, and rubber seal materials will also be degraded and hardened, leading to eventual damage and resulting in blockage of pore passages, orifices, and screen meshes.

In most cases, high-temperature oil combined with water and air causes more severe corrosion. Thinner oil may also increase wear due to greater impact and vibration, and may cause structural vibration, bearing loosening, and other damage. If lubricity is lost, the lubricating oil film is also lost, which causes contact between the metal of the cylinder and the metal surface to directly rub against each other, producing wear debris.

Temperature is a key factor in oil oxidation. Below 60°C, oxidation is negligible; above 60°C, the rate of chemical reaction approximately doubles for every 10°C increase. Above 60°C, the temperature further increases by 10°C and the life of the mineral oil decreases by about one-half, and at 100°C the useful life decreases to 97%.

Based on the above facts, the working temperature of the hydraulic system should ideally have a sufficient margin against oxidation reactions, keeping the hydraulic oil degradation to a minimum. However, the oil temperature is not necessarily the actual oil temperature, as the outlet temperature is the actual temperature, and local oxidation that is particularly severe in some areas also affects the overall surface condition.

Oil thermal stability refers to the ability of oil to resist decomposition caused by its own temperature. If the operating temperature exceeds the acceptable threshold for a prolonged period, the established maximum oil temperature limit is reached. It is worth noting that the vast majority of failures in hydraulic systems, especially in electro-hydraulic servo and proportional valve-controlled hydraulic cylinder control systems, are caused by hydraulic oil contamination. In particular, solid particles (contamination) cause the system to exhibit abnormal behavior and may present an otherwise unexplained failure. Therefore, the first concern should be whether the hydraulic oil contains solid particulate contamination.

7.3.1 Hydraulic Oil Contamination Assessment and Control
The hydraulic system uses hydraulic oil that should have a system with components, accessories, and related seals.
1. Hydraulic Oil Contamination Assessment
In the hydraulic system and components, pollutants or more or less exist.

In evaluation of this pollution degree, the quantitative index is the pollution level, and the qualitative index is the pollution degree. The pollution degree is inversely related to the cleanliness level.

Existing in hydraulic oil, solid particle contamination is defined in GB/T 14039-2002 "Hydraulic Fluid Power Transmission Oil Solid Particle Contamination Grade Code". In GB/Z 20423-2006 "Hydraulic System General Cleanliness Grade Inspection", the cleanliness grade of the hydraulic system is defined based on the pressure oil discharged from the pump.

In GB/T 27613-2011 "Hydraulic Fluid Power Transmission Oil Solid Particle Contamination Grade Determination Method", the method of measuring the solid particle contamination degree of the hydraulic system is defined using both membrane filtration and particle counting methods. This standard applies to hydraulic systems with working fluid particle contamination greater than 0.2mg/L.

In JB/T 9954-1999 "Hydraulic Machinery Hydraulic System Cleanliness Grade Determination Method", the cleanliness grade of the hydraulic system is defined. GB/T 14039-2002 and JB/T 10205-2010 "Hydraulic Fluid" are applicable.
2. Hydraulic Oil Pollution Degree Control

The hydraulic system contains various types of hydraulic components, attachments, pipelines (oil passages), oil, and working fluid. The hydraulic reservoir is a type of hydraulic component. The pollutants in the hydraulic system can be divided into two categories: those that reduce the performance of the hydraulic system and those that affect the cleanliness (pollution degree) control, which can achieve and maintain the desired cleanliness level. However, first control the cleanliness of the hydraulic oil itself.
(1) Hydraulic Oil Cleanliness Control

The hydraulic system has requirements for hydraulic oil cleanliness. According to the pressure oil requirements in the hydraulic system, the cleanliness level should be determined based on the requirements of the main pressure element or the requirements stated in the hydraulic component manual, to ensure that the hydraulic oil can meet the specified cleanliness level.

Newly added hydraulic oil cleanliness may be lower than the system requirements. In normal use of the hydraulic system, the cleanliness should be checked regularly according to the cleanliness requirements of the hydraulic system. The cleanliness should be maintained at the specified level. In addition, to prevent water contamination of hydraulic oil, the cleanliness control of hydraulic oil is an important aspect of hydraulic system maintenance. Water mixed in hydraulic oil will reduce the viscosity of the hydraulic oil, reduce the lubricity of the hydraulic oil, and cause corrosion of metal parts and emulsification of the oil. At low temperatures, the oil's water absorption capacity is reduced, and water can freeze and block small holes in the hydraulic components, causing system failure. When necessary, follow JB/T 12920-2016 "Hydraulic Fluid Transmission Oil Water Content Detection Method" to detect the water content of the hydraulic oil.

The method for controlling hydraulic oil cleanliness is given by the method of new oil filtration in the hydraulic component manual or according to the requirements stated in the manual, to ensure that the hydraulic oil can meet the specified cleanliness level.

New hydraulic oil cleanliness may be lower than system requirements. In normal use of the hydraulic system, cleanliness should be checked regularly according to the cleanliness requirements of the hydraulic system. The cleanliness should be maintained at the specified level.
(2) Hydraulic Reservoir Cleanliness Control

Due to the cleanliness (pollution degree) of the hydraulic reservoir, it can be used to control the pressure reservoir's internal pollution degree to at least meet the requirements of 2006 "Hydraulic Component Cleanliness Grade Determination Method for Hydraulic Fluid Elements" or through unit accumulation method to mark the pollution degree (see GB/T 14039-2002 "Hydraulic Fluid Power Transmission Oil Solid Particle Contamination Grade Code"). Therefore, the hydraulic reservoir cleanliness control is the use of pressure reservoir cleanliness (pollution degree) to meet the relevant standard requirements.

In JB/T 11588-2013 "Large Hydraulic Oil Reservoir", the cleanliness test of the hydraulic reservoir uses a one-stage pressure and one-stage discharge method, using pollution detection instruments to detect the oil discharged from the hydraulic reservoir.

In CB/T 3812-2013 "Ship Hydraulic Reservoir", the cleanliness of the hydraulic reservoir is determined by passing the cleaning liquid through the reservoir, and then the cleaning liquid is slowly poured into the small holes of the filter (with a cleanliness of 0.8μm) above the liquid level. After passing through the filter, the quality of the liquid before and after filtration is recorded to determine the amount of pollutants in the hydraulic oil.

sections.text: 7.3.3 Liquid pressure system and liquid pressure cylinder online dynamic monitoring and fault diagnosis

Online monitoring of the liquid pressure cylinder is the main way to use equipment to monitor the liquid pressure cylinder, the liquid system, the pressure sensor installed on the liquid pressure cylinder, the temperature, the input flow rate, the working condition pollution degree, the activity of the piston rod movement speed, the position and other parameters for monitoring.
1. Pressure monitoring

The liquid pressure cylinder online monitoring pressure is generally used by force, also connected to the pressure point force, digital pressure gauge instrument. Among them, the digital pressure gauge pressure block must be used in a unified manner. A general pressure gauge has a target monitoring. Permanent safety pressure gauge, should use the pressure control device (pressure gauge blocking device) or pressure gauge switch protection, and the pressure gauge switch closure frequency is completely closed. The pressure gauge measurement limit is at least 1.75 times the system pressure.

Also the pressure point force and digital pressure gauge further circulation detection to the pressure point force control other elements, limit or adjust the entire pressure gauge (liquid pressure system) pressure.

For pressure detection of liquid pressure cylinder pressure pressure table (or pressure sensor) measurement point position at the liquid pressure cylinder inlet 2-4 times the diameter of the light place.
2. Temperature monitoring

The liquid pressure cylinder online temperature monitoring device is generally installed in the box. In order to control the working temperature range of the work, a general pressure system on the upper design has a cooling device (also called a heat exchanger). The simplest temperature monitoring device is installed in the box of the liquid temperature gauge, it only uses a self-indicating measurement. The liquid pressure temperature gauge can control the temperature by oil temperature monitoring, can also be used for heat exchange device control. When the liquid pressure cylinder is checked, a general pressure gauge is used to measure the liquid pressure cylinder temperature measurement point position at the liquid pressure cylinder inlet 4-8 times the diameter of the light place.
3. Working quality and cleanliness monitoring

In addition to type, structure, and heavy pressure equipment, a general pressure system is composed of liquid equipment on the upper installation of working quality monitoring device (such as online particle counter). In order to strictly and accurately monitor the liquid pressure cylinder cleanliness of the work quality pollution degree, should be based on relevant standards to set the oil filter inlet. In the JB/T 11585-2013 (large pressure cylinder) medium defined oil pollution measurement (for pressure discharge of the oil discharge) for inspection.
4. Piston rod movement limit position monitoring

Non-liquid pressure cylinder actual limit position of a general pressure gauge, monitoring piston rod or piston rod position should be mainly to prevent the piston rod from touching the cylinder bottom or the guide sleeve (guide sleeve) contact, but the position of the piston rod activity should be carried out in the process of the fixed position. sections.text: 7.3.4 Hydraulic Pump On-site Maintenance and Preservation
1. Hydraulic Pump Maintenance Process
(1) Preparation

items: Hydraulic pump maintenance personnel should be trained by professional technicians with relevant experience.
Prepare maintenance plans, check for faults, prepare drawings, spare parts, disassembly tools, etc., and plan the work schedule.
Prepare a good maintenance location, handle external oil leakage and pollution, and ensure environmental cleanliness.

sections.text: Clean, pollution-free operation.

items: Disassemble the hydraulic pump - the main thing is to support and fix the parts (such as blocks, etc.), support, fix, and use installation tools to install.
Must align the corresponding parts after maintenance of the hydraulic pump (including the cleanliness) recovery, safety, and can be used for inspection and evaluation.
The hydraulic pump must stop running after inspection, including opening the total power source (power source).
Oil port treatment head after removal, should immediately take sealing structure, avoid and reduce environmental pollution.

sections.text: 8) When disassembling a hydraulic cylinder, the control valve should be completely closed. The control valve and the cylinder should be isolated from each other using a shut-off valve. The control valve should supply working pressure to guide the piston rod. Warning: When the hydraulic cylinder is connected to the oil pipeline and circuit, the pressure cylinder and all cylinders must be disconnected and the pressure must be relieved. Otherwise, disassembly of the hydraulic cylinder may cause danger.
(2) Disassembly

items: Disassemble the hydraulic cylinder according to the drawing and work instructions. Clean the disassembled parts and inspect them for damage.

Before disassembly, if no safety device is installed, the pressure cylinder should be depressurized. After depressurization, the hydraulic cylinder surface should be cleaned and pollution removed. The work environment should be clean and the pollution level should match the hydraulic cylinder maintenance requirements.
After cleaning, the hydraulic cylinder assembly should be selected for selective disassembly and records should be made.

The active seal (system) and static seal (system) on the seal must be checked. After inspection, disassembly should be performed at the specified time. The seal under the seal (including guide, support, etc.) must be removed, but should be stored for a period of time.

Remove the external shape and size of the hydraulic cylinder, the piston rod, the active valve, the guide sleeve, the piston rod diameter, the guide sleeve outer diameter, and the main dimensions. Perform detailed analysis of the test data.

Check the root cause of the failure. It should be determined by a single science. According to the engineering technical knowledge of the staff, the failure analysis report of the hydraulic cylinder and its components should be prepared. The specific items include: failure mode, damage, modification of the design plan, and return of defective products (report, etc.).

Determine the inspection items for the repair. It should also have a failure analysis report. For the hydraulic cylinder and its components, the parts that are severely damaged or have serious defects should be checked in detail.

sections.text: (3) Maintenance

items: Maintenance of the hydraulic cylinder requires disassembly and assembly work.
The disassembled hydraulic cylinder cannot be welded.
Maintenance cannot exceed the environmental requirements of the hydraulic cylinder and its components. It is not possible to exceed the environmental requirements in the hole.

sections.text: 4) Maintenance after the hydraulic cylinder is reassembled should meet the relevant standards. For example, the piston rod diameter, piston rod length, piston rod thread, oil port, and seal should be checked.

5) For specific issues, specific analysis, and the use of safety, reliability, and fast, reliable repair methods are required. In general, except for the replacement of sealing parts, support rings, and other parts, the hydraulic cylinder and its components can be repaired.
6) Due to rigidity and stiffness issues, the broken cylinder component is generally not reusable, that is, "irreparable".
(4) Assembly

items: The hydraulic cylinder assembly should be carried out according to the assembly pressure installation process.
When assembling the hydraulic cylinder, the original parts must be combined parts. If the original parts are used, the original parts must be approved before assembly.
All original seals must be completely replaced, including piston rings, support rings, etc.
Ensure that the hydraulic cylinder is clean and meets the requirements.
(5) Test
After maintenance, the hydraulic cylinder should be tested in a test stand that meets the test standards before being installed on the main machine.
When using the main hydraulic system to test the hydraulic cylinder, there are potential dangers. Possible dangers include:
① Unpredictable operation and misoperation.
② Hydraulic pressure, hydraulic shock, and flying debris.
③ Overpressure and explosion.
④ Other parts of the hydraulic cylinder have high pressure.
3) At least pass the sealed seal performance test. The hydraulic cylinder should not be able to move the sealed parts (such as blocks).

4) The hydraulic cylinder is in a no-load state, low-pressure operation is performed several times, and the internal air is exhausted. After the internal air is clean, the pressure-driven connection is re-operated.
5) Use a thermometer to measure the temperature rise of the hydraulic cylinder.

sections.text: 2. Hydraulic Cylinder Maintenance

Hydraulic cylinders should be maintained to ensure the safety and reliability of hydraulic cylinders. Extending the service life of hydraulic cylinders is important for all aspects of use. The maintenance of hydraulic cylinders should include the following:

items: Check and clean, replace the oil filter element.
Ensure that the heat exchanger is clean and the heat dissipation is good.
Regularly check the oil quality and replace the oil as needed.
Check the specified inspection points regularly, ensure that the hydraulic cylinder is operating within the specified temperature range.
Regularly check the hydraulic cylinder installation and connection.
Check the piston rod protection and replace it if necessary.
Check the cylinder connection for leaks and repair as needed, and ensure that all seals (including rings, support rings, etc.) are intact.
Generally, hydraulic cylinders have undergone violent vibration, tilt, and tilting.

sections.text: After the test is completed, re-commissioning work should be carried out.

items.text: If a fault occurs in the hydraulic accumulator and timely repair is not possible, the work should not continue.
For long-term idle hydraulic accumulators, the liquid in the accumulator should be drained to relieve pressure, but the air space pressure should not be emptied.
Keep the external surface of the hydraulic accumulator free from rust, and repaint as needed.
Keep the nameplate and warning signs intact.
When transporting the accumulator, do not use it as a part of the hydraulic accumulator.

Use the designated hydraulic fluid for the accumulator. If continuous use is required, special protection should be provided. The hydraulic accumulator is a precision hydraulic component that requires professional and technical personnel to maintain and protect it. The maintenance and protection of the hydraulic accumulator should comply with the technical documents of the hydraulic machinery, and must be implemented.
